Position: Administrative Assistant

Company: Brandcoven

Location: Remote, USA

Contract Details: Part-time/Full time

Brandcoven is a fast-growing digital marketing agency that specializes in helping businesses build their brand and reach their target audience through strategic marketing strategies. We are currently seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to join our team on a part-time or full-time basis. This position will be remote, allowing you the flexibility to work from the comfort of your own home.

As an Administrative Assistant, you will play a crucial role in supporting our team and ensuring the smooth operation of our daily tasks. Your responsibilities will include managing calendars, scheduling appointments, coordinating meetings, and handling various administrative tasks. You will also be responsible for organizing and maintaining digital files, as well as assisting with client communication and project management.

The ideal candidate for this position is someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to multitask effectively. You should have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, and be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Prior experience in an administrative role is preferred, but not required.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage calendars and schedule appointments for team members
  • Coordinate meetings and handle all necessary logistics
  • Organize and maintain digital files and documents
  • Assist with client communication and project management
  • Handle various administrative tasks as needed
  • Provide general support to the team as needed

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent; additional qualifications as an Administrative Assistant or Secretary are a plus
  • Proven experience in an administrative role
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Highly organized with the ability to multitask and prioritize tasks effectively
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and Google Suite
  • Familiarity with project management tools is a plus
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy

Benefits:
- Flexible schedule and work arrangements (Hybrid and remote)

- Comprehensive health benefits

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Opportunity to work with diverse clients and drive business growth.
- Collaborative and dynamic work environment.
- Professional growth and development opportunities.

If you are a self-motivated individual with a passion for organization and a desire to work in a dynamic and growing company, we would love to hear from you.

This is a great opportunity to join a talented team and make a significant impact on our company's success. Apply now and become a part of the Brandcoven family!

raw.description:
Compensation Range:

$ 175-$250K

Job Title: Senior Director, Strategic Technology Partnerships

Location: US REMOTE

Industry: Data Center Cooling / Thermal Management / Digital Infrastructure

Company: Munters Corporation

About US: Munters is a global leader in climate solutions for mission-critical processes. We offer innovative, efficient and sustainable solutions for customers in industries where controlling indoor humidity, temperature and energy efficiency is mission critical. Climate control systems often account for a large percentage of energy consumption in many of our customers’ operations. With an optimal climate system, we can help them to more efficiently use energy or water resources and thereby reduce their climate and environmental impact. Sustainability is an important part of Munters’ business strategy and value creation. We pride ourselves on fostering a dynamic and inclusive work environment where interns are valued members of the team and are given meaningful projects to work on.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a senior leader to help shape the future of our company’s growth by building strategic relationships across the upstream data center technology ecosystem – including chip manufacturers, server manufacturers, OEMs, ODMs & Hyperscale’s who are developing the next generation of computing.

The purpose of this role is to give the company early visibility into where compute, server and rack-level architecture are headed, translate those shifts into future cooling and thermal-management requirements, and help position our product roadmap and partnerships ahead of market demand. The ideal candidate will bring deep industry knowledge, strong executive-level relationships, and a proven ability to connect technology roadmaps across semiconductor, server, OEM, ODM, and hyperscale ecosystems.

This person will serve as a bridge between external technology leaders and our internal commercial and engineering teams, helping us anticipate future cooling and thermal-management needs and position our products and partnerships ahead of market demand.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and lead an ecosystem strategy for upstream data center technology players, including chip manufacturers, server OEMs/ODMs, rack/system designers, hyperscale’s, and other key partners.
  • Build and maintain senior commercial and technical relationships that provide early visibility into computing, server, rack, power, and cooling technology roadmaps.
  • Monitor technology trends in processors, accelerators, server architecture, rack density, power consumption, liquid cooling, and thermal management.
  • Translate external technology trends and partner roadmaps into actionable insights for internal product strategy, engineering priorities, and innovation planning.
  • Connect our engineering and technical teams with counterpart technical teams at strategic partner organizations.
  • Identify and develop opportunities for early design involvement, joint development, co-development, and long-term strategic partnerships.
  • Help position the company to develop products and solutions that are market-ready as next-generation technologies are commercialized.
  • Influence internal planning by providing forward-looking market intelligence rather than relying solely on direct customer requests.
  • Represent the company at key industry events, consortiums, standards groups, and executive meetings.

Education/Desired Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; technical or business advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of senior-level business development, strategic partnerships, or market development experience in one or more of the following:
  • Data center infrastructure/Thermal management / cooling/ Server hardware/Semiconductor / chip ecosystem/Digital infrastructure
  • Strong existing network of contacts within chip manufacturers, server manufacturers, OEMs, ODMs, and related technology providers.
  • Demonstrated success building relationships that lead to strategic partnerships, co-development opportunities, or early access to product/technology roadmaps.
  • Strong understanding of how semiconductors and server technology impact data center infrastructure requirements, especially cooling and thermal design.
  • Experience working across technical and commercial teams and translating market direction into product strategy.
  • Executive presence and the ability to engage credibly with senior leaders, engineers, and product teams across multiple organizations.
  • Strong communication, influence, and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience in international business environments and cross-cultural collaboration preferred.
  • Experience working with or selling into hyperscale’s, colocation providers, server manufacturers, or semiconductor companies.
  • Familiarity with emerging cooling technologies, including liquid cooling, direct-to-chip, immersion, high-density rack cooling, and related thermal solutions.
  • Participation in industry associations, standards bodies, or technical forums relevant to data centers, servers, or advanced computing.
  • Proven ability to identify future market requirements before formal customer demand is established.

Benefits:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Generous vacation and paid time off
  • 401K retirement savings plan with employer matching
  • Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement, and conference attendance
  • Company-sponsored social events and team-building activities

Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

All offers are contingent on a pre-employment drug test and background check, as applicable for the position.

raw.excerpt: At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential.
raw.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

We are seeking a 10xer to lead our growth product efforts for maximizing our member acquisition and enrollment funnels. The ideal candidate is a high-velocity and analytical systems thinker who has deep expertise with building high performing conversion funnels. This is a role for a strategic thinker and a doer: someone who can see the big picture but isn't afraid to get their hands dirty building and executing.

This is a hands-on role. You'll manage two PMs and still write specs, analyze data, and ship experiments yourself. If you only want to be a people manager and want to operate through others, this isn't it.

This isn't a "maintenance" role; you will be the primary person accountable for step level improving all of our efforts on member growth through the funnel. You will own the entire funnel from landing pages through enrollment finished for our members. You are accountable for maximizing member acquisition and enrollment conversion.

Team

The Growth team is responsible for maximizing member growth across all solutions within Sword.

What you'll be doing:

  • The full member funnel. Landing pages, eligibility checks, registration, enrollment. You own the systems and the conversion metric through member enrollment.
  • The experimentation system, roadmap and decisions to drive results. You decide what we test, in what order, and what we do with the result.
  • Build systems that increase operational leverage. Client-specific requests, maintenance, new launches and new initiatives consume team capacity. You'll find what's repeatable, productize it into configuration instead of custom work, and use AI to automate the rest.

What you need to have:

  • 10+ years in product management building consumer-facing products or B2B2C platforms, including 4+ years managing PMs and Senior PMs.
  • Strong consumer product mindset with proven CRO track record. Deep understanding of consumer behavior, friction, and motivation, with experience building intuitive journeys
  • Deep expertise from acquisition through activation — landing page experimentation through to activated members, not just top-of-funnel. Come ready to walk through funnels you owned, the tests you ran, and the conversion rates before and after.
  • Ownership at scale. You've driven significant decisions and can engage deeply on data, experimentation, and technical tradeoffs. You work well with engineers because you understand what you're asking for.
  • Customer and data obsessed. Combines funnel data, user insights, and experimentation to understand behavior and improve the member experience and business results.
  • Highly analytical. You can conduct your own analysis, size opportunities before building, and can tell a real result from noise.
  • AI-Forward: You use AI tools to increase your personal and team output. You understand the difference between "adding a chatbot" and building an AI-driven growth ecosystem.
  • Bias for action: Thrives in ambiguity, makes decisions fast, and validates assumptions early. Proven ability to thrive in ambiguity, adapting quickly to changing priorities while maintaining high quality standards.
  • Systems thinker. You look at a problem and see the mechanism producing it, not just the symptom.
  • Strong opinions, held with evidence — and willing to be wrong in public.
  • Outcome orientation: Relentless focus on metrics and results.
  • Exceptional written communication. Our teams are globally distributed and async-first; if your thinking only lands in a live meeting, it won't scale here. Strong project management and a bias for urgency.
  • Cross-functional leadership. Proven ability to align Business units, Engineering, Client-facing teams, Design, Data, and Growth around shared funnel outcomes.
  • User-first mindset: Ability to translate complexity into simple, intuitive, and cohesive user experiences.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in digital health or consumer health products.
  • B2B2C, benefits, insurance, or fintech — anywhere the buyer and the user are different people.
  • Experience with eligibility, identity matching, or enrollment systems.
  • A/B testing and experimentation at scale, including the infrastructure behind it.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML applied to personalization, recommendations, or behavior change.

*The range below reflects base, variable, and equity for this role.

This is a starting point, not a ceiling — once someone joins and proves they're outlier talent, we adjust quickly to make sure their compensation matches their impact.

Job titles may span more than one career level, so actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience, location, and market demand, among other factors. The range reflects base salary plus any variable, bonus, or sales incentives, and our estimate of the value of private company stock options where applicable. It's subject to change, and future stock value isn't guaranteed. Sword also offers additional benefits beyond total compensation.

Total Compensation Range
€105.000—€165.000 EUR
Country-specific benefits may vary and will be detailed separately.
Sword Health complies with applicable Federal and State civil rights laws and does not discriminate on the basis of Age, Ancestry, Color, Citizenship, Gender, Gender expression, Gender identity, Gender information, Marital status, Medical condition, National origin, Physical or mental disability, Pregnancy, Race, Religion, Caste, Sexual orientation, and Veteran status.

With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Manager, Executive Compensation


Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.

Labcorp is seeking a remote Manager, Executive Compensation to join our team.

(Applicants who live within 35 miles of either the Burlington, NC or Durham, NC location will follow a hybrid schedule. This schedule includes a minimum of three in-office days per week and two days working remotely, supporting both collaboration and flexibility)



Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8am - 5pm, Eastern Time Zone

Responsibilities

  • Support overall program management and administration of executive compensation
  • Collaborate with HR business partners and rewards leadership to review executive roles and recommend appropriate grade and pay level for new hires, promotions and retention reviews
  • Support material development for the Compensation and Human Capital Committee meetings
  • Conduct extensive research related to executive compensation market trends, including that available in publicly disclosed financial documents (proxy, 10-ks, 8-ks, etc.)
  • Oversee participation in third party market surveys for executive positions
  • Assist with the administration of the global compensation planning processes including merit, bonus, and equity
  • Administer global Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), including monitoring employee eligibility, purchase auditing and refund processing
  • Stay updated on industry trends and regulatory changes to support recommendations for program enhancements
  • Provide analytical support regarding ad hoc research and other related executive compensation projects
  • Demonstrate understanding of the requirements/data elements to create reports which streamline and support compensation programs
  • Conduct executive compensation M&A due diligence and support integration
  • Provide direction and oversight to junior staff

​

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree with 3 years of executive or broad based compensation experience, Associates degree with 5 years of executive or broad based compensation experience or HSD with 7 years of executive or broad based compensation experience ​

Preferred Qualifications

  • 1 or more years of Executive Compensation Consulting company experience
  • Certified Executive Compensation Professional (World at Work certification) ​

Additional Job Standards

  • Strong collaboration, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
  • Critical high-level attention to data integrity and accuracy
  • Advanced skills related to data gathering and manipulation for business analysis
  • Ability to effectively establish, manage, and leverage relationships with internal and external partners
  • Project management skills
  • Advanced knowledge of Excel
  • Advanced PowerPoint skills
  • HRIS skills
  • Being cognizant of the urgency and time sensitivity related to executive compensation requests
  • Demonstration to problem solve and think outside-of-the-box / self-starter
  • Strong analytical, organizational, communication skills
  • Capable of managing multi-task assignments simultaneously
  • Comfortable reading/writing internal business documents, policy statements, and process reviews

Provides support to Global Rewards Team on a variety of programs and projects with particular focus on executive compensation, Compensation Committee material development, equity planning and Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) administration. May also support sales and broad-based compensation programs as needed.


Pay Range: $115,000-$130,000 base + annual bonus

Application window closes: 10/30/26

Company Description

At Saatchi we believe in creating ideas that can live anywhere. And we believe that when we work as a team, nothing is impossible. We strive to bring out the best in each other and in ourselves and expect applicants to understand the value of close collaboration. We also believe that creating transformational work requires initiative, an entrepreneurial spirit and a bold commitment to achieving measurable results and business success for the Clients we service.

Overview

The Saatchi Analytics team believes the value of analytics is not simply in producing data, but in helping teams make smarter marketing decisions through thoughtful analysis, clear storytelling, and actionable insights.

The Senior Analyst is a hands-on role supporting 1-3 analysis in the time allotted. This person will work across multiple projects and datasets, using strong exploratory data analysis skills to assess data quality, identify meaningful patterns, and translate findings into clear insights.

Success in this role requires curiosity, analytical rigor, and adaptability. The ideal candidate is comfortable being given an unfamiliar dataset and an open-ended business question, independently determining the appropriate analytical approach, and clearly communicating what the data tells us.

Responsibilities

  • Independently evaluate new datasets and determine appropriate analytical approaches based on the business question.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis across a variety of marketing and advertising datasets. This could include campaign performance, survey results, market insights (sales, purchase motivators, etc.).
    • Clean, structure, and QA datasets to ensure analyses are accurate and reliable.
    • Perform descriptive analysis to identify trends, patterns, outliers, relationships, and opportunities for deeper investigation.
    • Translate analytical findings into clear observations, insights, and implications for internal teams.
  • Support multiple analytics projects and deliverables, shifting between different business questions and datasets as priorities evolve.
  • Identify opportunities to improve analytical processes through automation, AI, or more efficient workflows.
  • Partner with Analytics Directors to support broader client analyses and deliverables.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in analytics, preferably within advertising, media, research, or a related field.
  • Strong exploratory data analysis skills, including data cleaning, QA, descriptive analysis, and interpretation.
  • Advanced Excel skills and demonstrated experience working with large or complex datasets. Experience with Python, R, and/or SQL not required, but ideal.
  • Ability to independently approach ambiguous or open-ended analytical questions and determine what can be learned from the available data.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to distinguish meaningful findings from noise.

Additional Information

Our Publicis Groupe motto “Viva La Différence” means we’re better together, and we believe that our differences make us stronger. It means we honor and celebrate all identities, across all facets of intersectionality, and it underpins all that we do as an organization. Our benefits package includes medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401K, as well as parental and family care leave, family forming assistance, tuition reimbursement, and flexible time off.

If you require accommodation or assistance with the application or onboarding process specifically, please contact .

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. Temporary roles may be eligible to participate in our freelancer/temporary employee medical plan through a third-party benefits administration system once certain criteria have been met. Overview

Sr. Human Resources Generalist - Join Our Dynamic Team at CHOICE Healthcare Services!

At CHOICE Healthcare Services, our mission is to provide everyone with access to the healthcare they need. CHOICE is the largest provider of pediatric dental care in the Southwest United States, and we pride ourselves on delivering high-quality care to children in our communities. Job Description


This role will be key to ensure strong monitoring in our clinical trials. Under the oversight of the Clinical Research Director (CRD) or Head of Site Management and Monitoring, the person is responsible to manage a team of 6-14 Clinical Research Associates (CRAs)and to ensure excellent study and site performance with strict adherence to local regulations, company SOPs and ICH GCP.


As Associate Director, the role is critical to continuously develop key talents by providing training, support and mentoring to the CRAs and properly manage situation of low or non-performance.


The role will work at country level with other local stakeholder e.g. Clinical Research Managers (CRM) to ensure alignment and development of the country capabilities. The role will collaborate with country Partner Line Managers (PLMs) to ensure alignment across all monitoring functions. The person contributes to HQ capacity/resource planning activities to ensure efficient allocation of resources and work.


This person will work primarily in Vaccine/Infectious Disease with some Cardiovascular therapeutic areas.

  • Experience working with Microsoft Office Suite
  • Self-motivated and goal/ metrics driven
  • Can problem solve independently and assist with escalations as needed
  • Superior organization and multitasking capabilities
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment with a high degree of autonomy
  • Professional, confident, outgoing demeanor

  • Exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality, and exercise good judgment

Why Deephaven Mortgage?

Deephaven Mortgage has been a pioneer and leader in non-QM since our origin in 2012. Our longevity and strength in the non-QM space has allowed a significant number of borrowers to achieve homeownership who otherwise would not have under traditional requirements. Deephaven champions mortgage borrowers whose independence, entrepreneurial drive and determination are often the very reason they cannot qualify for a traditional loan.

We continuously and responsibly innovate new mortgage products and programs that put homeownership within reach of millions of borrowers and investors that need and deserve financing through lending ingenuity that is supported by common-sense underwriting.

Deephaven is comprised of two lending platforms. Our wholesale channel offers loans through a network of over 1,000 independent mortgage brokers. Our correspondent channel buys loans from over 200 correspondent partners.

Deephaven’s headquarters are in Charlotte, North Carolina. To learn more about our innovative loan solutions please visit www.deephavenmortgage.com or email us at .

Job Overview

In this role, you will be responsible for evaluating complex mortgage loan applications that fall outside traditional Qualified Mortgage (QM) guidelines. You will assess borrower risk based on alternative documentation, ensure compliance with company policies and investor guidelines, and play a key role in decision-making for loan approvals.

What You’ll Do

  • Manually underwrite mortgage loan transactions submitted by our Correspondent and Wholesale lending clients to company and investor credit guidelines

  • Perform quality control audits of our third-party vendor to ensure mortgage loans met all company and investor credit guidelines and requirements

  • Review loan scenarios and communicate purchase/funding eligibility requirements to our Correspondent and Wholesale lending clients

  • Collaborate with internal staff (e.g., Underwriters, Account Managers, Processors, Closers, Operations Management, etc.) of our correspondent lending clients, brokers and third party-vendors throughout the review process to clear purchase/funding eligibility conditions

  • Work closely with processing staff to clear loan conditions throughout the process

  • Assist in handling loan-level credit and compliance questions & issues and in the preparation and dissemination of updated mortgage underwriting and compliance standards and procedures

  • Any and all other duties as requested by management

Job Requirements

  • Recent, hands-on Non-QM underwriting experience is required, including, but not limited to:

    • DSCR

    • Bank Statement (personal & business)

    • P&L–only qualification

    • Asset Depletion

    • Multi-family

  • Experience underwriting HELOCs and 2nd mortgages strongly preferred.

  • 15+ years of experience as an underwriter

  • Ability to manually calculate income across all Non-QM programs, including complex self-employed borrower profiles, layered income sources, and variable cash flow.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently review and clear:

    • Title commitments & supporting documentation

    • Appraisal reports (including complex or unique property types)

    • Full condo project reviews (warrantable, non-warrantable, new construction, and small projects)

  • Proficiency in Encompass, with the ability to navigate workflows, analyze documentation, and manage conditions efficiently.

  • High-volume underwriting background, managing 50+ initial underwrites per month while maintaining quality, accuracy, and fast SLAs.

  • Strong understanding of Non-QM guidelines, investor overlays, compensating factors, and risk layering.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly document decisions and collaborate with sales, processors, and closers.

  • Strong critical-thinking, independent-decision-making, and problem-solving skills.

  • Commitment to loan quality, compliance, and responsible lending.

Compensation

The compensation band for this role begins at $52.88 per hour, plus a performance based monthly bonus plan.

More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. The Engagement Lead is one of the ED&D’s primary client-facing owners, who is accountable for bridging delivery execution with strategic advisory, and commercial stewardship. This role owns the ED&D end-to-end client engagement— ensuring delivery excellence, leading the client delivery team (Architects, Data Engineers, Developers, Business Analysts, and Quality Assurance) that supports the solution, deepening relationships (internal and external), identifying (and or leading growth pursuits) growth opportunities, and connecting clients to the broader capabilities of the dentsu organization.


Depending on assignment, this role may have one or more ongoing client engagements, lead project-based work, or do both concurrently. In all engagements the expectation is the same: show up consultatively, own the outcomes, and bring synergy across teams to create genuine value for clients.


Engagement Leads are conversant across modern data and MarTech stacks and can lead value conversations without relying on a technical translator. Data is their lens for every client interaction: understanding how it flows, how it activates, and how it drives measurable customer experience outcomes and business results.

Engagement Leads should be familiar with general capabilities such as:

  • Data Platforms: Snowflake, Databricks, Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Fabric
  • Customer Data Platforms: Adobe Real-Time CDP, Salesforce Data Cloud, Tealium, Segment, Treasure Data, and Hightouch
  • Activation & Orchestration: Adobe Journey Optimizer, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, Iterable, Oracle Responsys
  • undefined

Whether embedded in a long-term client relationship or leading a defined scope of work, an Engagement Lead is proactive by default, commercially minded, intellectually curious about clients' businesses, and committed to continuous learning, including hands-on engagement with AI tools as a standard part of how they work.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in client delivery (technology services preferred)

Key Responsibilities


Client Ownership & Relationship Development·

Technical Acumen & Consultative Advisory·

Delivery Accountability & Team Leadership·

  • Serve as the internal escalation point and external face of accountability when delivery risks arise, resolving proactively rather than reactively·
  • Coach and empower retained teams and/or pod members (Architects, Data Engineers, Business Analysts, and Consultants) to engage directly with clients while retaining overall ownership of the relationship·

  • Data Governance & Compliance·

Commercial Growth & Account Expansion·

Efficiency & AI-Enabled Delivery·

raw.excerpt: Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.
raw.description:
Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.
We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.
Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.
Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.
Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.
- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.
- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.
- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.
- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About The Role

    Flex is hiring a General Manager to build and run its construction business. You own the sector end to end: the strategy for winning it, the relationships and partnerships that open it, the product priorities it needs, and the P&L it produces. You build on Flex’s platform, balance sheet and teams, and you are responsible for making Flex the primary financial institution for construction.

    The role is modeled on sector coverage at an investment bank. You decide which relationships matter, which partnerships can move hundreds of owners onto Flex at once, and what the product must deliver to win them. Flex’s product, credit, risk and member experience teams execute and service alongside you. The role reports directly to the CEO.

    Construction is one of the largest and most capital-intensive owner-operated sectors in Flex’s range. Contractors, specialty trades, developers and building-products distributors carry long receivable cycles, bonding requirements and heavy equipment and payroll spend, and they decide where to bank on the advice of a small circle of sureties, lenders, associations and software vendors. The General Manager owns that circle.

What You'll Do

    • Own the sector P&L. You are accountable for one number: owners in construction banking with Flex and the revenue they generate. You build the model behind it, report against it weekly, and answer for it.

    • Map the sector and cover it. Within 90 days you have identified the 200 people who move construction and have a coverage plan for each. From then on, that is where your time goes.

    • Originate. Bring owners and firms to Flex directly, through dinners, site visits, conferences, portfolio days and referrals. You represent Flex in your sector and you are expected to be present in it.

    • Structure the partnerships that move the sector. A surety or construction-lender referral program. A trade association. A franchisor or buying group. A construction ERP integration. A sponsor rolling Flex across a portfolio of contractors. You identify them, negotiate them, and own the relationship after signature.

    • Set the product agenda for your sector. You tell product leadership what owners require before they will move their primary banking relationship, in what order, and why.

    • Build the team as the book grows. You begin with Flex’s account executives, account managers and member experience team supporting you. When the pipeline exceeds what one person can cover, you hire and lead your own sector team.

    • Work AI-native. Research, relationship tracking, outreach and modeling run on tools you build or adopt, so your time goes to relationships.

Requirements

    • 7 to 12 years in investment banking, private credit, private equity, venture, or a senior commercial seat inside construction. You have a demonstrable record of originating business, not servicing it.

    • An active network in construction. You can name the 50 people who matter and most of them would take your call this week.

    • Fluent in how contractors are paid and where their capital gets tied up: margins, working capital, pay applications, retainage, bonding, and who lends against each.

    • Comfortable structuring partnerships, negotiating referral economics, and working through a term sheet without support.

    • You build your own models. Banker-level Excel and a working understanding of the unit economics of deposits, cards and credit.

Nice To Haves

    • Experience in fintech, banking or lending, or selling a financial product to business owners.

    • A standing in construction: a podcast, a newsletter, a conference stage, or a board seat at a trade body.

    • Investing, advisory or operating experience in a company in construction.

How To Prepare

    As part of the application, please be prepared to submit a one-pager along with your CV on how you would bring construction to Flex. It should cover:

    • The sector and its owners. Who they are, how many of them fall in Flex’s range, how they make money and where their capital gets tied up.

    • What they need from a bank. The products and terms that would make owners in the sector move their primary relationship, and in what order.

    • The map. The 20 to 30 people and institutions that move the sector, and how many of them you know personally

    • The first three partnerships. The programs that would put hundreds of owners on Flex at once, and why each counterparty would say yes.

    • The investment and the return. A light P&L for the sector: what Flex would need to put in over the first two years (people, product, partnership economics, marketing) and how that investment comes back, in the form of owners banking with Flex and the revenue they produce. We are looking for the shape of the business and the logic behind it.

    • The plan and the team. How you will build this out and you will need to do it.

      • Treat it as a coverage pitch. Bring the map, the partnerships and the economics, and be ready to defend each one.

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.
Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.
Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.
True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.
Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.
High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.
Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.
Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

EBSCO Information Services (EBSCO) delivers a fully optimized research experience, seamlessly integrated with a powerful discovery platform to support the information needs and maximize the research experience of our end-users. Headquartered in Ipswich, MA, EBSCO employs more than 2,700 people worldwide, with most embracing hybrid or remote work models. Our mission is to transform lives by providing reliable and relevant information — when, where and how people need it. We’re seeking dynamic, creative individuals whose diverse perspectives will help us achieve this global, inclusive mission. Join us to help make an impact.

Our mission is to transform lives by providing reliable and relevant information — when, where and how people need it. We’re seeking dynamic, creative individuals whose diverse perspectives will help us achieve this global, inclusive mission. Join us to help make an impact.

Your Opportunity

The Customer Success Executive (CSE) partners with EBSCO Clinical Decisions customers to ensure successful onboarding, product adoption, and long-term value realization of EBSCO solutions. Acting as the primary point of contact post-sale, CSEs collaborate with internal teams including Sales, Marketing, Product, and Editorial to deliver a seamless and value-driven customer experience.

This Customer Success Executive will support customers across the North Midwest and West Coast regions. Candidates should be open to travel and located within 45 minutes of a major metropolitan airport. Ideally, candidates will be based in the Chicago or Denver area.

What You'll Do

Drive Value & Strategic Alignment

  • Review each customer’s Value Hypothesis and align product capabilities to stated needs and success metrics.
  • Establish clear timelines and KPIs to guide value realization.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to proactively deliver recommendations that enhance outcomes and demonstrate product impact.

Lead Onboarding & Enablement

  • Define onboarding goals, deliver change management support, and coordinate with the Clinical Implementation team.
  • Support awareness campaigns and provide product training to ensure users understand key features and use cases.
  • Empower internal product champions and share self-service resources to promote internal adoption.

Support Technical Implementation

  • Lead the end-to-end onboarding process for EBSCO Clinical Decisions products
  • Provide expert guidance and support to customers during the implementation process, coordinating with IT teams to ensure that the system is properly configured and integrated with existing systems, including EHR integration, toolbar links, IdP SSO via SAML and SMART on FHIR, HL7 Infobutton & Mobile Device Management (MDM)
  • Manage Implementation timelines, resources, and budgets to ensure project milestones are met.

  • Track and report on key performance indicators to evaluate the success of the implementation.

Ensure Ongoing Success & Growth

  • Deliver proactive, data-driven engagement strategies that sustain usage and satisfaction throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Monitor product usage against KPIs and offer strategic interventions to prevent churn and promote growth.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in health administration, information technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in project management, customer engagement, success, marketing, or support roles
  • Strong understanding of clinical workflows, EHR systems, and SSO authentication protocols.
  • Medical experience to provide a clear understanding of clinical workflow
  • Proven track record of successfully managing complex implementation projects.
  • Excellent written and oral communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.

  • What sets you apart:
  • 7 years of experience in project management and experience within the healthcare industry.

raw.description:
Overview

Geosyntec has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Director level Hydrogeologist to join our contaminated land practice in the UK. This position is suited to a talented, highly motivated individual with extensive experience in contaminated land, groundwater assessment and remediation consulting, who is interested in leading and contributing to our innovative and challenging projects. The successful candidate could be based near one of our offices in Manchester, Bristol or Delph, or fully remote.

Geosyntec is an international engineering and consulting firm serving private and public-sector clients to address their new ventures and complex problems involving our environment, natural resources, and civil infrastructure. Our engineers, scientists, technical and project employees serve our clients from offices across the world. Ranked by ENR as one of the top environmental engineering design firms, Geosyntec is internationally known for its technical leadership, broad experience, and exceptional client service.

We invest in our people. Each employee is unique, and your career at Geosyntec will be too. We offer competitive pay and benefits, and well-being programs to support you and your family.

To Learn More Visit:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

We expect that you will work on a wide variety of challenging technical projects and will help Geosyntec expand its current practices and capabilities. Collaboration and mentoring are cornerstones of Geosyntec’s culture. You can expect to work closely with experienced professionals across our UK & Ireland business, who will help integrate you into Geosyntec’s culture and advance your career ambitions.

Your responsibilities may include:

  • Growing our site investigation & remediation practice through client relationships, business development efforts and implementing market growth initiatives
  • Project management, including planning and implementing investigation and remediation projects, budgeting and budget management, meeting project schedules, quality requirements and client expectations.
  • Data assessment and development of conceptual site models
  • Design, implement and interpret hydrogeological field test results (e.g. slug testing, pumping tests, packer tests etc.)
  • Design, development and calibration of groundwater models to assess groundwater migration/problems and where needed solute transport, or thermal modelling.
  • Undertaking risk assessments (controlled waters and human health) using both analytical and (where appropriate) numerical packages.
  • Interpretation of modelling results to answer project objects and identify/develop remediation criteria or further works including the design of further works, site investigations, and/or remediation strategies etc.
  • Management of fieldwork tasks including site inspections, multi-media environmental sampling and characterisation, drilling oversight, contractor oversight, and management of remediation system operations and maintenance.
  • Management of remediation treatability and pilot tests with subsequent data evaluation, report writing and work plan development.
  • Management, training and mentoring of early and mid-career professionals.
  • Preparing technical reports, letters, memoranda, plans, specifications, and proposals.
  • Preparing for and participating in meetings with clients, regulatory personnel, and other parties; and
  • Supporting the senior team in client care and development activities.

Geosyntec offers professional development opportunities including attendance and presenting at technical conferences, in-house seminars, webinars, and mentoring, which allow our professionals to build the technical and business skills necessary to become successful consultants. You will be able to engage with our global technical action groups, which promote collaboration across the company as well as individual professional development. Geosyntec will also provide health and safety training, first aid training and medical monitoring, as required, which will be paid for by the firm.

Education and Licensure

  • Bachelor's degree in geology, earth sciences, environmental engineering, or a related field of study. (required)
  • Advanced degree in hydrogeology, or a related field of study (desirable but not essential)
  • Professional registration (e.g. CGeol / CSci / EurGeol). (desirable)

Skills, Experience and Qualifications

  • At least 15 years of direct environmental consulting experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. (required)
  • Demonstrable track record of project delivery in the site investigation and remediation sector. (required)
  • Experience of directing and managing the overall delivery of projects including project planning and controls, financial management, change management, risk management, and contract/subcontract management. (required)
  • Ability to succeed in a fast-paced consulting environment, handling multiple project assignments and meeting strict deadlines. (required)
  • Current OSHA 40-hr HAZWOPER training and refreshers. (preferred)
  • Field work and overnight travel may be required.
  • Health & Safety training, medical monitoring, and client-driven drug and background testing may be required.
  • Valid UK driver’s license and a satisfactory driving record for business travel. (required)

The Senior Program Manager (Business Architect) will lead the development and delivery of interoperability and Electronic Health Record (EHR) strategies that support Cigna’s business, clinical, and regulatory objectives. This role connects strategy, governance, business architecture, and execution—from evaluating opportunities and defining capabilities through business case development, prioritization, implementation, and value realization. The role will collaborate across business, clinical, technology, product, and delivery teams to enable secure, bi-directional payer-provider data exchange, optimize EHR platforms, improve workflows, and translate approved initiatives into measurable outcomes.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Define the strategic intent, scope, target outcomes, risks, benefits, and product or capability strategy in partnership with business, clinical, product, and technology stakeholders.
  • Assess current-state capabilities, workflows, systems, and operating models; identify gaps; and define the future-state business capabilities.
  • Lead cross-functional impact assessments and apply consistent evaluation criteria—including clinical and business value, regulatory requirements, feasibility, risk, dependencies, and organizational capacity—to prioritize opportunities against the existing portfolio and roadmap.
  • Develop lean business cases that articulate strategic alignment, operational impacts, dependencies, risks, implementation considerations, and measures of success.
  • Translate opportunities into actionable plans with clear sponsorship, funding, requirements, delivery milestones, and success measures.
  • Lead the integration, implementation, and optimization of Epic Payer Platform and other EHR and interoperability capabilities that enable secure, reliable, and bi-directional data exchange between payer and provider.
  • Partner across business, clinical, product, technology, and delivery teams to improve end-to-end workflows and ensure solutions align with data privacy, security, regulatory, and enterprise architecture standards.
  • Develop implementation, market readiness, and adoption strategies that help teams successfully use new capabilities.
  • Provide end-to-end oversight from solution design through operational adoption by guiding decisions, managing dependencies and escalations, and resolving delivery risks.
  • Maintain visibility into the interoperability initiatives and communicate priorities, decisions, progress, risks, and project synergies to stakeholders and leadership.

Demonstrated Knowledge & Technical Skills:

  • Ability to groom an opportunity from high-level concept to well-defined solution ready for implementation.
  • Able to perform current state process discovery and pain points/root causes analysis.
  • Design future state processes to deliver novel solutions and resolve operational pain points.

Level of Leadership:

  • Self-directed and capable of leading a team, either as a direct manager or as a part of a matrixed team

raw.excerpt: About airSlateairSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions.
raw.description:
About airSlate

airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award-winning products - SignNow, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms - serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work.
We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the United States, Poland, Ukraine and Philippines.
At airSlate, we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.

Who we are

airSlate built a $1800M+ business serving dozens of millions of users across pdfFiller, SignNow, DocHub, AltaFlow and Instapage, on the back of a proprietary long-tail marketing engine. AI is now disrupting the core of that business and, at the same time, opening up a much bigger opportunity: solving the underlying business outcome end to end — draft, sign, track, invoice, collect — not just the document step.

The opportunity

We're running the company as two deliberately separate efforts. Our legacy portfolio — pdfFiller, DocHub, SignNow, AltaFlow — which we're optimizing for defensible 3-5 year revenue to fund what's next. AI Labs: a structurally separate, AI-native business we're building from scratch, targeting $20-50M of new topline in 2-3 years.
AI Labs is already proving the model works. BizDraft — AI-drafted agreements for SMBs — has shipped and is our learning vehicle for running a ~90% AI-driven product end to end. Ordinum, an AI compliance agent for regulated SMBs, is in development. BizPulse, which reconstructs a small business's financial and operational reality straight from its inbox, is in a controlled experiment. Alongside the products, AI Labs has rebuilt the pdfFiller editor from scratch (5x faster, 10x smaller) and stood up internal AI systems — Discovery Engine, document-based segmentation, Synthetic Users, Zero Reporting — that are starting to change how the rest of the company works.
We need a product leader to take AI Labs from "proving the model" to a real business.

The role

You'll own product for AI Labs: strategy, roadmap, and definition across our AI-native product line (BizDraft, Ordinum, BizPulse, and whatever comes next). You lead a small group of Product Owners, and will work in tight lockstep with AI Labs' engineering leadership, who own the build team.
A small go-to-market team — one product marketer and one marketer — supports AI Labs today, and you'll work closely with them on market analysis, idea generation, triage and prioritization, positioning, and launch.

What you'll do:

  • Own product strategy and roadmap for AI Labs, targeting $20-50M in new AI-native topline over 2-3 years
  • Scale BizDraft post-launch, drive Ordinum and BizPulse through to go/no-go for launch
  • Identify, size and prioritize 2 to 5 more high-potential projects, based on established customer needs and a potential competitive advantage for airSlate
  • Hire and lead a very small team of AI-native, 0-to-1 Product Owners, each owning the build out of a specific product against the prioritized ideas, and developing it based on customer and market feedback
  • Develop a working understanding of our existing products (pdfFiller, SignNow, DocHub, AltaFlow) and their customers, to surface needs and use cases AI Labs can act on — some of which may be better rolled into an existing product as a feature rather than launched as a standalone AI Labs product
  • Define product requirements and priorities with the precision AI-driven execution demands
  • Partner closely with AI Labs' engineering lead on sequencing and trade-offs, without owning the engineering team directly
  • Decide which internal AI systems incubated in Labs (Discovery Engine, segmentation, Synthetic Users, Zero Reporting, etc.) are ready to hand off to a functional owner — Marketing, CIO, Data — once proven, and which stay in Labs
  • Partner with the AI Labs go-to-market team on positioning, GTM planning, and launch execution for each product as it matures
  • Represent AI Labs product progress to the executive team and the board

Who you are:

  • Experienced in building 0-to-1 inside a larger company
  • A builder-operator who has shipped AI-native products end to end — or at the very least, transformative standalone features or modules on top of existing products, with proven adoption success
  • Deeply fluent in AI-assisted build workflows (Claude Code, OpenAI's Codex and the like) and what they change about team shape, ratios, and the product definition bar
  • Comfortable driving product outcomes through precision and influence rather than headcount — you won't have an engineering team reporting to you
  • Commercially minded — comfortable partnering closely with marketing and PMM on positioning and GTM
  • Low ego and collaborative — able to earn credibility with engineering leadership and peers rather than assume it from the org chart
  • SaaS, SMB, and document/workflow space experience a plus

Why this and not somewhere else

Ownership of product for the most ambitious green-field initiative in the company, with real budget and a mandate to help build a $20-50M+ business from scratch — backed by a company with 100M+ users and proven distribution.

What we offer

Flexible working environment - Our teams operate across the globe. We value in‑person collaboration in our hubs, but we also embrace remote and hybrid working. You can work from one of our offices in the United States, Poland, Romania or Ukraine, or remotely from many countries.
Competitive compensation and stock options - We offer salaries that reflect local market conditions and experience, plus a performance-based bonus system and stock options so you share in the company’s growth.
Professional growth and learning - We invest in your development through courses, conferences, and access to learning resources. We encourage career growth and internal mobility, supporting teammates who want to explore new opportunities within airSlate.
Health and well‑being - We provide comprehensive benefits tailored to each country, including health coverage, wellness programmes and access to fitness options. We also dedicate quarterly company-wide Mental Health Days, when everyone takes time off to rest and recharge.
Family‑friendly culture - Family life is part of who we are, and we embrace it in many forms. From flexibility for parents to our airSlate Junior Club for kids, to company-wide family days and our pet-friendly approach, we’re committed to making work and life easier to balance.
Giving back - We support charitable initiatives around the world through the airSlate Care programme. Our current focus includes humanitarian aid in Ukraine and other regions, matching employee donations and supporting causes chosen by our teams.
Open communication - We encourage transparent dialogue at all levels. From team discussions to company-wide Q&A sessions with our CEO, we make sure everyone has the chance to be heard and to influence how we grow.

raw.title: Director, IT Operations
raw.excerpt: OverviewHealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market.
raw.description:
Overview

HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Director, IT Operations is accountable for establishing and operating the service-management governance model for Client IT Operations. This leader will create the standards, operating discipline, governance, and management mechanisms required to deliver consistent, predictable, and transparent technology operations across a complex 24x7 BPaaS/EPaaS environment.

The role is designed to be a force multiplier for operational teams: strengthening Incident, Problem/RCA, Change, Release, Knowledge, and Service Governance practices while ensuring that technical ownership remains with the teams responsible for resolution. The Director will drive cross-functional accountability, executive-quality communications, and measurable continuous improvement across onshore and offshore delivery organizations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and lead the Service Management Office, including the governance framework, operating cadence, standards, controls, templates, and performance mechanisms used across Client IT Operations.
  • Own the service-management process framework for Incident Management, Problem Management/RCA, Change Management, Release Management, Knowledge Management, and related service-governance practices.
  • Establish clear roles, decision rights, escalation paths, and accountability across Tech Ops, infrastructure/platform teams, product teams, implementation teams, Service Desk, customers, and third-party partners.
  • Lead governance for major incidents and service disruptions, ensuring disciplined process execution, timely stakeholder engagement, effective bridge management, clear escalation, and high-quality internal and customer communications.
  • Define and enforce RCA standards, including ownership, timelines, evidence quality, corrective/preventive actions, cross-functional follow-through, and closure governance.
  • Lead Change and Release governance, including CAB effectiveness, production-readiness controls, risk assessment, rollback/testing expectations, release calendars, and post-change validation.
  • Create consistent executive and customer communication standards for incidents, service health, operational risk, planned changes, and material service issues.
  • Develop service governance scorecards and management reporting covering SLA performance, incident trends, change quality, RCA completion, recurring failure patterns, operational risk, and continuous-improvement commitments.
  • Partner with technical leaders to identify systemic operational issues and convert recurring incidents, manual processes, and control gaps into prioritized improvement initiatives.
  • Drive standardization across customer environments while allowing documented exceptions where contractual, technical, or customer-specific requirements demand variation.
  • Partner with tooling and observability teams to improve ITSM workflows, Jira/JSM utilization, telemetry, alerting, automation, and the quality of operational data used for governance and decision-making.
  • Establish and maintain service-management documentation, playbooks, templates, knowledge standards, and audit-ready evidence.
  • Build an effective onshore/offshore operating model that uses follow-the-sun capabilities while maintaining appropriate leadership, customer engagement, and executive communication coverage.
  • Develop SMO talent, establish measurable objectives, coach leaders and practitioners, and create a culture of ownership, transparency, urgency, and continuous improvement.

ROLE BOUNDARIES AND OPERATING PRINCIPLES

  • The SMO owns the process, governance, communication standards, escalation discipline, and enforcement mechanisms; technical teams retain accountability for technical diagnosis, remediation, recovery, and permanent corrective action.
  • Incident Management facilitates coordinated response and communication; the responsible Technical Operations Manager, Technical Lead, Technical Director, platform, product, or engineering owner remains accountable for technical resolution.
  • The SMO is expected to challenge weak process execution, unclear ownership, inadequate evidence, missed commitments, and recurring operational failure regardless of organizational boundary.
  • Governance must improve speed and quality of delivery; controls should be risk-based, measurable, and increasingly automated.

LEADERSHIP & STAKEHOLDER RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a senior operational partner to the VP, Client IT Operations and other technology and business leaders.
  • Influence across organizational boundaries without relying solely on direct reporting relationships.
  • Provide concise, fact-based executive updates during high-severity events and periods of elevated operational risk.
  • Build trusted working relationships with customer-facing leaders, Technical Operations Managers, Technical Directors, infrastructure/platform teams, product and implementation organizations, vendors, and offshore delivery leaders.
  • Escalate systemic risks and accountability gaps early, with clear recommendations and decisions required.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in IT operations, service management, production support, technology delivery, or related disciplines, including significant leadership responsibility.
  • Demonstrated leadership of enterprise Incident, Problem, Change, Release, or broader IT Service Management functions in complex, high-availability environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of ITIL practices and the ability to translate frameworks into pragmatic operating processes rather than compliance-only administration.
  • Experience leading major-incident response, executive/customer communications, RCA governance, and cross-functional remediation.
  • Proven ability to design or materially improve service-management operating models, governance structures, workflows, metrics, and tooling.
  • Experience operating across global onshore/offshore teams and 24x7 service environments.
  • Strong analytical capability with experience using operational data, trends, and service metrics to identify risk and drive improvement.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex operational issues clearly to executives and customers.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive accountability and change across teams where authority is distributed.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in healthcare technology, healthcare payer operations, BPaaS, SaaS, EPaaS, or other highly regulated/transaction-intensive environments.
  • Experience with Jira Service Management (JSM), enterprise ITSM platforms, observability/monitoring platforms, PagerDuty or comparable on-call tooling, and workflow automation.
  • Experience supporting environments with significant customer-specific integrations, data operations, third-party dependencies, and complex production release requirements.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS

  • Consistent adoption of defined service-management standards across Client IT Operations.
  • Improved major-incident execution, communication quality, escalation speed, and stakeholder confidence.
  • Reduced repeat incidents through stronger RCA quality, corrective-action governance, and problem management.
  • Improved change success rate and reduced change-related incidents through stronger readiness and risk controls.
  • Clear, timely, and reliable operational reporting with fewer manual reconciliations and conflicting sources of truth.
  • Reduced ambiguity in ownership and faster resolution of cross-functional operational issues.
  • Measurable reduction in operational risk, process variance, and avoidable manual effort.
  • A scalable SMO organization viewed by delivery teams as an enabler of better operations and by leadership as a reliable source of operational truth.

LEADERSHIP PROFILE

The successful candidate will be a pragmatic operator who combines service-management discipline with strong judgment, executive presence, and the willingness to hold teams accountable. This role requires someone who can move comfortably between a Sev1 bridge, an executive review, a customer discussion, a process-design session, and a data-driven operating review—and who understands that the objective of governance is better service outcomes.

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

**The annual US base salary range for this position is $182,000 to $198,000. This salary range may cover multiple career levels at HealthEdge. Final compensation will be determined during the interview process and is based on a combination of factors including, but not limited to, your skills, experience, qualifications and education.
