raw.description:
GROW WITH US:
Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.

STAY AWESOME:
Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

The Regional Account Manager - Market access is responsible for establishing and managing strategic relationships with regional health plans, health systems, pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs), State health plans, Medicaid plans, and other related stakeholders that influence their geography. This individual will lead contract negotiations, manage access strategy, and drive execution with a focus on pharmacy benefit access, pull-through, and data-driven performance. The role requires cross-functional collaboration, value-based discussions, and field enablement to ensure broad patient access and business growth.

This is a remote role and the ideal candidate will reside in the Detroit, Chicago, Indy, Milwaukee, or Cleveland area.


RAMs at Tandem are also responsible for:

  • Access Strategy & Contracting
    • Leads contract negotiation and execution with regional and downstream PBMs, health plans, employers and specialty/retail pharmacy networks.
    • Develops tailored value propositions using financial modeling, claims analytics, and health economic data.
    • Secures pharmacy formulary coverage, distribution agreements, and reimbursement pathways aligned to product lifecycle and channel strategy.
    • Partners with internal legal, pricing, and finance teams to structure pharmacy agreements that balance growth and profitability.
  • Pull-Through & Execution
    • Drives execution of pharmacy access strategies across field sales, inside sales, and market access teams.
    • Translates contract terms into actionable tools and messaging for the field to optimize pull-through.
    • Serves as lead point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring operational execution, service level adherence, and issue resolution.
  • Relationship Management
    • Builds and maintains senior-level relationships within PBMs, specialty pharmacies, employers and payer organizations to influence formulary and utilization management policy.
    • Represents the organization in business reviews, renegotiation cycles, and quarterly performance meetings with assigned accounts.
    • Collaborates with patient services, reimbursement, and distribution teams to optimize pharmacy hub and specialty fulfillment partnerships.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategy
    • Monitors market trends, competitor access, and policy shifts that impact pharmacy distribution and reimbursement.
    • Informs access strategy with insights into payer mix, pharmacy benefit adoption, biosimilar dynamics, step-edits, and tiering.
    • Provides strategic input into brand planning, pricing, and evidence generation needs.
    • Supports the evolution of hybrid (medical + pharmacy) access models as the landscape shifts toward simpler, scalable solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership
    • Collaborates with Trade & Distribution, Reimbursement, Patient Support, Legal, and Medical Affairs to align on pharmacy strategy.
    • Partners with sales leadership to ensure timely and coordinated pull-through across geographies.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in a life science, business or marketing or a combination of equivalent education and applicable job experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in Market Access, Regional Accounts, or Managed Markets within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industries.
  • Demonstrated success negotiating contracts with PBMs, health plans, or specialty pharmacy networks.
  • Prior experience working in a company with a strong pharmacy-first or hybrid distribution model preferred.
  • Deep understanding of the pharmacy benefit landscape, PBM contracting, pharmacy reimbursement, and specialty distribution.
  • Strong analytical acumen with the ability to leverage data sets and turn them into actionable account strategies.
  • Proven negotiation and influencing skills with C-suite and senior executives within payer and pharmacy organizations.
  • Experience in hub services, patient access programs, and co-pay assistance models.

WHEN & WHERE YOU’LL WORK:

Remote: This position is fully remote and open to candidates within the United States in the Great Lakes area; living in the Detroit, Chicago, Indy, Milwaukee, or Cleveland areas. Equipment for the role will be provided and training will occur virtually.


TRAVEL:

Ability to travel up to 50% as required and work from a home office; must maintain valid driver’s license and required auto insurance as well as good driving record, per company policy.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

The starting base pay range for this position is $160,000 - $189,000annually plus incentive compensation (commission-based compensation is based on the achievement of goals). Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes bonus and a robust benefits package.


Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!


YOU SHOULD KNOW:

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information.


Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders.


SPONSORSHIP:

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:
At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at .

BE YOU, WITH US!

We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us.

Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.

REFERRALS:
We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share!

APPLICATION DEADLINE:
The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.

Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow.

Decile Group () is the leading agentic platform for fund administration. Our AI-native infrastructure lets emerging managers launch, run, and scale a VC fund without the overhead that used to make it impossible. We just closed three record-breaking quarters in a row. Hundreds of managers have launched on our platform, and the pipeline keeps accelerating.
Every fund admin platform your prospects have heard of was built before the agentic era. They run on manual reconciliation, junior staff, and siloed systems that don't talk to each other. Their clients get slow K-1s, surprise invoices, and a back office that runs like it's 2015.
Decile was built differently. One data layer across legal, compliance, treasury, accounting, and LP management. AI handles the heavy lifting. Ultra-senior staff on every account. K-1s delivered in March when everyone else is still working on theirs in May. Institutional-grade operations at emerging manager scale.
Your prospects are out there funding AI companies. Their own operations should run like one. Decile is built for 2026 and beyond. That's the story you get to tell.

Scam Warning

VC Lab and Decile Group never conduct hiring interviews via chat, and we will never ask candidates to send money, purchase equipment, or share financial information. Scammers may impersonate real employee names. If you are contacted about a role outside our official channels, do not engage.

The Role

    We don't need someone who runs a playbook. We need someone who writes the next one. Your job is to fill our pipeline with emerging GPs by finding channels nobody else is using, testing them quickly, and scaling the ones that work. Some weeks that's cold outbound. Other weeks it's an X thread that takes off, a LinkedIn series, a community you start from nothing, or an AI agent you build that books meetings while you sleep.

What You'll Do

  • Generate qualified meetings with emerging fund managers through any channel that works.
  • Run a steady stream of growth experiments, kill the losers fast, and double down on the winners.
  • Build a presence on X and LinkedIn that pulls GPs to us instead of us chasing them.
  • Build and use AI agents and automations to do the work of a five-person team.
  • Share what you learn every week so the whole company gets smarter about growth.

Who You Are

  • Creative, with a growth mindset. You see a blank page and get excited, not stuck.
  • Strong on social. You know how to write a post people stop scrolling for.
  • Agentic. You don't wait for permission or a perfect plan; you ship, measure, and iterate.
  • Fast. You'd rather run ten scrappy tests this week than one polished one next month.
  • A builder. You're comfortable with AI tools, automation, and figuring out new software on your own.
  • Bonus: you know venture, fintech, or selling to investors.
To apply, send us your resume and one growth experiment you ran: what you tried, what happened, and what you learned.

What you will bring to the role

  • Proficiencywith electronic data capture (EDC) systems, data visualization tools, and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex data clearly to diverse stakeholders.

  • Collaborative, adaptable team player with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively across all levels of an organization.

Your experience

Revenue Process Design & Standardization

raw.description:
The Senior Product Manager for Clean Rooms and Data Delivery Platforms is responsible for defining and executing Acxiom’s strategy for client and partner based clean-room implementations and the platforms used to securely manage and deliver Acxiom and client-owned data.

This role owns products and capabilities supporting privacy conscious data collaboration, onboarding, enrichment, audience creation, analysis, measurement, and activation across online and offline channels. The Product Manager will ensure Acxiom’s cleanroom and delivery solutions meet client needs while remaining scalable, interoperable, commercially viable, and aligned with Acxiom’s Real Identity and data strategy.

Duties and Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Ownership

  • Serve as the product owner for client and partner cleanroom implementations and supporting data delivery platform capabilities.
  • Define product strategy, roadmaps, and priorities for privacy-conscious data collaboration and delivery solutions.
  • Establish a consistent approach for supporting Acxiom data, client first-party data, and partner data within cleanroom and Acxiom environments.
  • Align product direction with Acxiom’s Real Identity, data enrichment, activation, measurement, and platform modernization strategies.
  • Balance client and partner specific implementation requirements with the development of scalable, reusable product capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize data onboarding, permissions, processing, and delivery across clients and partners.

Clean-Room Product Management

  • Lead product planning and execution for client and partner-based clean-room implementations.
  • Define requirements for data ingestion, identity resolution, data matching, enrichment, collaboration, analysis, measurement, and activation.
  • Establish repeatable implementation patterns that reduce time to market and improve consistency across cleanroom providers and client environments.
  • Partner with clients and providers to define supported use cases, data flows, identity requirements, access controls, outputs, and success criteria.
  • Develop product requirements supporting both one-to-one client implementations and scalable one-to-many partner solutions.
  • Ensure cleanroom capabilities support appropriate interoperability with Acxiom Real Identity and related data products.
  • Manage platform and partner dependencies, including changes that may affect existing client implementations.

Data Delivery Platform Management

  • Own the product strategy for platforms that house, process, and deliver Acxiom and client-owned data.
  • Establish requirements for secure data ingestion, storage, transformation, permissioning, access, distribution, and monitoring.
  • Support delivery through batch files, APIs, cloud storage, database sharing, and other approved delivery methods.
  • Partner with architecture and engineering to improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Drive modernization of legacy delivery workflows and migration to reusable platform services.
  • Define operational tools and controls needed by delivery, implementation, support, and client-facing teams.

Client and Partner Implementation

  • Translate client and partner needs into prioritized product requirements, implementation plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Participate in technical and business design sessions covering data flows, identity, permitted uses, delivery methods, and platform integration.
  • Provide product leadership throughout implementation, launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
  • Develop repeatable implementation playbooks, requirements templates, and readiness criteria.
  • Ensure custom implementation work is evaluated for broader product applicability and potential reuse.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position does not typically have direct reports but is expected to mentor other product managers and provide leadership across cross-functional client, partner, product, engineering, and delivery teams.



Qualifications

Required

  • Five or more years of product management or related experience, including ownership of complex data, platform, or enterprise technology products.
  • The position is not eligible for any type of sponsorship
  • The candidate will be located in the EST/CST timezone.
  • Experience leading multiple concurrent product initiatives or client implementations.
  • Strong knowledge of product management methodologies, roadmap development, prioritization, and product lifecycle management.
  • Experience translating client and technical requirements into scalable product capabilities.
  • Domain experience in marketing data, identity, data collaboration, clean rooms, data delivery, advertising technology, marketing technology, or another information-intensive business.
  • Working knowledge of first and third-party data.
  • Understanding of online and offline marketing use cases, including audience creation, activation, enrichment, analytics, and measurement.
  • Experience partnering with engineering, architecture, data operations, delivery, privacy, legal, security, Sales, and account teams.
  • Strong client-facing and partner-management experience.
  • Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to lead complex initiatives and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Experience defining and measuring product, operational, financial, and client-success metrics.

Preferred

  • Knowledge of Acxiom Real Identity, Acxiom data products, and Acxiom delivery and activation capabilities.
  • Experience implementing solutions with clean-room providers, cloud data platforms, or data collaboration partners.
  • Knowledge of identity resolution, identity graphs, pseudonymous identifiers, data matching, and audience population workflows.
  • Experience with cloud storage, database sharing, batch delivery, APIs, and secure data-transfer patterns.
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, and GCP.
  • Experience managing platforms that host or process both provider-owned and client-owned data.
  • Experience supporting both digital activation and offline data delivery.
  • Experience with product pricing, packaging, go-to-market planning, and enterprise client engagement.
  • Experience modernizing legacy data delivery processes or transitioning client workflows to shared platform services.
  • Familiarity with privacy technologies, data governance controls, and regulated data environments.

Travel

Up to 25%.

Primary Location City/State:

Homebased - Conway, Arkansas

Additional Locations (if applicable):

Overview

Nakupuna Companies is looking for a Systems & Integration Support Analyst to provide Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP) Business Systems Center (BSC) contractor support services. This role analyzes and refines system requirements, supports application engineering and integration, and helps sustain assigned applications and modules. Support services include requirements elicitation, architecture and interface analysis, prototyping, testing, documentation, release support, and collaboration with Mission Partners, users, and application technical teams.

Responsibilities

The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign additional duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons.

  • Perform functions related to design, software engineering and programming, unit testing, and maintenance of assigned applications and modules.
  • Analyze and refine system requirements; determine and design system and application architecture; and develop and maintain system and application documentation using defined software-development processes.
  • Provide an application-engineering perspective when interfacing with Mission Partners, users, and technical teams.
  • Evaluate new technology tools and methodologies, support application engineering, and provide technical advice to the team, management, and Mission Partners or users.
  • Recommend recognized system-engineering best practices that improve the supportability, survivability, reliability, and maintainability of program code.
  • Perform required testing against acceptance criteria and definition of done to assure software and system quality and functionality.
  • Determine the feasibility of design alternatives, translate systems requirements into application prototypes, and develop problem resolutions.
  • Provide functional authority and functional knowledge expertise for assigned applications and perform assigned tasks for those applications.
  • Obtain requirements from Mission Partners and users.
  • Identify, define, or modify interfaces with other systems and applications, ensuring agreements are formally documented with the interfacing system or application.
  • Provide pre-implementation training resources to Mission Partners and users.
  • Develop documentation based on Agile Scrum best practices and the NAVSUP BSC Service Delivery Model.
  • Support production outages, development of release packages, work-item updates in Azure DevOps Services, and internal review or change boards.
  • Analyze system requirements and convert functional design to detailed logic for coding into computer language for assigned software systems, including modules and components.
  • Review each module and the overall system for design validity, including validation of record input, data elements, and output reports.
  • Compile and submit executables for assigned systems in accordance with established standards.
  • Conduct quality audits of NAVSUP products, perform causative research on errors, and provide corrective action.
  • Maintain a professional relationship with clients, team members, and internal and external agencies and organizations.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: Shall have two years or more of experience and knowledge in the following areas:

  • Two or more years of experience and knowledge performing software-engineering, systems-analysis, application-integration, or related technical activities.
  • Knowledge of the design and implementation of computer and database-management systems.
  • Knowledge of current software and database engineering methodologies, design techniques, and applicable software and database standards.
  • Experience with one or more programming languages.
  • Experience with Microsoft development tools and the analysis, development, maintenance, and testing of applications.
  • Excellent technical, organizational, planning, oral and written communication, problem-solving, attention-to-detail, and decision-making skills.

The following are desirable qualifications or levels of experience:

  • Experience with Microsoft Visual Studio, C#, .NET Core, .NET Framework, and SQL development with Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, web-application development, and web-application environments.
  • Experience with service-based architectures, APIs, REST, SOAP, and event-driven architectures.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and application-security principles.
  • Experience developing test plans and conducting or coordinating unit, integration, and user-acceptance testing.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Microsoft O365 and Teams, Excel, Visio, and Outlook applications.
  • Knowledge of DevSecOps patterns and practices, including CI/CD pipelines and version control.
  • Knowledge of Amazon Web Services architecture.
  • IAT Level II certification.

Education and Experience

Bachelor’s degree with a technical major, such as engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related discipline, is required. The degree requirement may be substituted with two years of college or technical education and three to five years of related work experience.

Experience with government and DoD environments is desired.

Military Installation Access: Must be able to qualify for and obtain a base access pass. Must be able to obtain a favorable National Security Agency Check (NACI), including an FBI fingerprint check. Must be a U.S. citizen.

Travel: Travel will not occur regularly and will typically be less than 5% of the time.

Location: This is a remote position.

Physical Requirements: The ideal candidate must at a minimum be able to meet the following physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation:

  • Ability to perform repetitive motions with the hands, wrists, and fingers.
  • Ability to engage in and follow audible communications in emergency situations.
  • Ability to sit for prolonged periods at a desk and work on a computer.

The Nakupuna Companies use a market-based compensation strategy to ensure that our employees are compensated within applicable market ranges commensurate with multiple factors, including but not limited to the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability, organizational requirements, and position location. The projected compensation range for this position is $120,000.00 to $140,000.00 (annualized USD). The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Nakupuna Companies total compensation package for employees.

Job Description

As a Customer Success Manager focused on direct tax, you will translate complex tax rules and changing regulations into practical guidance, helping clients stay ahead of change and make confident decisions in every filing season.

Customer Success is not just a function or team at Thomson Reuters, but also our reason for doing business. We measure our success based on the prioritization of our customers' needs and goals. The relationship we create with our customers determines the future benefits for them and our company. The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is assigned a book of business specific to Concierge and/or Advisory customers, responsible for the development of customers' knowledge on their suite of offerings. The CSM will manage these customers to drive performance towards Thomson Reuters' strategic objectives and retention goals. This will require the management of multiple projects with strong business acumen to remove obstacles interfering with the growth and retention of customers.

Key Responsibilities
In this opportunity as a Customer Success Manager, you will:

  • Partner with customers to define success, deliver educational activities throughout their lifecycle, and track progress toward business outcomes
  • Develop and share best practices and Customer Success Plans, collaborating with internal teams like Sales and Professional Services
  • Monitor customer health by tracking usage data and escalating critical concerns, using insights to drive strategic adjustments
  • Identify and activate commercial growth opportunities, recommending improvements based on customer maturity and working closely with the commercial team
  • Ensure customers receive maximum value from their investment, driving retention and growth through tailored engagement and collaboration
  • Leverage technology tools (e.g., Gainsight, Salesforce) to manage client information, pipeline, and financial forecasts accurately
  • Build and present business plans, report on market and competitor activities, and represent Customer Success in cross-functional meetings to support business objectives

Required Qualifications
You are a fit for the role of Customer Success Manager if you have:

  • 8+ years of professional experience, with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in customer success
  • Direct Tax experience
  • 4-year college degree required
  • Experience working in and around cloud software solutions and cloud delivery models
  • Strong business acumen and communication skills; can manage a customer journey, conflict resolution, and problem-solving.
  • Ability to travel, 25%

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or equivalent
  • Salesforce user experience
  • Functional/technical skills in SaaS implementations and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) applications

What’s in it For You?

  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance:Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

  • Career Development and Growth:By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

  • Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

  • Culture:Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

  • Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

  • Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The target total cash compensation range varies across locations.For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the target total cash compensation range for this role is $93,100 USD - $172,900 USD.Pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay and any target sales incentive are part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs.Target total cash compensation ranges are inclusive of both base pay and any target sales incentive.This job posting will close 12/31/2026.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.

More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com

SAP ECP Payroll Specialist

Next Generation, Inc., an HR-Path company, is seeking a Payroll specialist with experience in SAP ECP to join our team either fully remotely, or hybrid in the Atlanta area. Our Managed Payroll Services (MPS) team provides ongoing payroll operations and support for multiple clients utilizing SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll (ECP). We help organizations process payroll accurately, maintain compliance, and continuously improve their payroll operations.

This role will be responsible for processing payrolls for multiple clients utilizing SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll (ECP) and Payroll Control Center (PCC). The ideal candidate will have hands-on payroll processing experience within SAP ECP environments, strong attention to detail, excellent client service skills, and the ability to manage multiple payroll cycles simultaneously.

  • Process payroll for multiple clients using SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll (ECP)
  • Execute payroll cycles including regular, off-cycle, bonus, and adjustment payrolls

  • Experience processing payroll for medium to large employee populations
  • Strong understanding of U.S. payroll regulations, payroll taxes, garnishments, and employee deductions

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple clients and payroll schedules simultaneously

raw.description:
What We Can Achieve Together:


As the Reporting & Private Awards Specialist for the Great Plains Division, you will provide centralized reporting, award administration, and financial reporting support as part of the Great Plains Division Finance Operations & Enablement Team. Reporting to the Finance Operations & Enablement Director, you will be responsible for preparing, coordinating, and maintaining accurate financial reports for internal stakeholders, donors, private awards, and partner organizations while supporting consistent reporting practices across multiple Pods/BUs.


You will serve as a subject matter resource for financial reporting requirements and help ensure financial data is complete, accurate, timely, and compliant with donor, organizational, and regulatory requirements. You will collaborate closely with Finance Directors, Finance Managers, Budget & Forecast Specialists, Development staff, and Accounting Specialists to support financial transparency, stewardship, and decision-making.


Other areas of responsibilities include, but are not limited to:


Private Award Financial Management & Reporting

  • Coordinate financial reporting requirements for private awards, donor-funded projects, and other restricted funding sources.
  • Prepare and submit accurate financial reports in accordance with award agreements, donor requirements, and organizational standards.
  • Monitor financial activity against approved award budgets and funding restrictions.
  • Identify, investigate, and resolve reporting discrepancies or compliance concerns.
  • Partner with Development and program staff to support financial stewardship and donor accountability, including notifying staff of needed end-date extensions and monitoring award payments.
  • Maintain documentation and audit support files for awarded funds and reporting activities.
  • Responsible for closing Private Awards.

Financial Reporting

  • Ensure reporting consistency through standardized templates, methodologies, and data definitions.
  • Support preparation of internal management reporting, conservation reporting, and external reporting requirements.
  • Assist with board, donor, and partner reporting deliverables as assigned.

Process Standardization & Documentation

  • Maintain standardized reporting procedures and reporting calendars.
  • Develop and update reporting guides, job aids, and process documentation.
  • Collaborate across Divisions in the implementation of new reporting tools, dashboards, and process improvements.
  • Recommend enhancements that improve report accuracy, efficiency, and user experience.
  • Participate in finance process improvement and automation initiatives.

Stakeholder Support & Training

  • Respond to reporting and award-related inquiries from Finance Managers, Directors, and program staff.
  • Provide guidance regarding reporting requirements, financial data interpretation, and reporting schedules.
  • Support training efforts related to reporting tools, templates, and financial stewardship requirements.
  • Serve as a resource for questions regarding private award financial reporting processes.

Compliance & Internal Controls

  • Ensure financial reports comply with organizational policies, donor requirements, and applicable accounting standards.
  • Support audit requests and compliance reviews related to reporting and private awards.
  • Maintain appropriate documentation supporting reported financial results.
  • Adhere to established internal control and financial governance practices.

This is a remote position located within in the Great Plains Division (Arkansas, Iowa, Minnesota, Missouri, Kansas, Nebraska, North Dakota, South Dakota, Oklahoma, and Texas) and strong preference for individuals who are able to support partners in the Central Time zone.


We’re Looking for You:


Are you looking for work you can believe in? At TNC we strive to embody a philosophy of Work that You Can Believe in where you can feel like you are making a difference every day. We’re looking for someone with strong organizational skills to support reporting and private award administration across multiple Pods/BUs, and who can exercise judgment in interpreting reporting requirements and resolve data discrepancies. If you're attentive to detail, able to multitask, and comfortable working independently and as a collaborative team player who contributes to organizational consistency through standardized reporting practices, then this is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the ongoing mission of conservation by directing and shaping the work of our team!

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field and 3 years' related experience or equivalent combination.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience using Workday including data entry, reporting, recruiting, and/or other functions.
  • Experience with accounting/financial issues and analysis.
  • Experience using accounting and financial reporting systems.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting applications.
  • Ability to manipulate, analyze, and interpret data.
  • Technical experience with spreadsheet programs, general ledger reports and financial management tools.
  • Experience with GAAP and fund accounting principles, practices and regulations.
  • Experience, coursework or other training with U.S. Federal Uniform Guidance, state and local regulations, multilateral and international regulations, and standard contract clauses, as applicable.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Multi-lingual skills and/or multi-cultural experience appreciated.
  • Experience with donor-funded, grant-funded, or restricted-funding environments.
  • Experience supporting external financial reporting requirements.
  • Knowledge of non-profit accounting and stewardship practices.
  • Experience with financial dashboards, business intelligence tools, or report automation.
  • Familiarity with award compliance, budget monitoring, and project accounting.

This position requires a valid driver's license and compliance with TNC’s Auto Safety Program. Employees may not drive Conservancy-owned/leased vehicles, rental cars, or personal vehicles on behalf of the Conservancy if considered "high risk drivers." To learn more about the Auto Safety Program, visit the Auto Safety information page. Employment in this position will be contingent upon completion of a Vehicle Use Agreement, which may include a review of the prospective employee's motor vehicle record.

Salary Information:


The starting pay range for a candidate selected for this position is generally within the range of $53,000 – $83,400. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. Where a successful candidate’s actual pay will fall within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including, for example, the candidate's location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. Please note countries outside the USA would have a different pay range in the local currency based on the local labor market, and not tied to USA pay or ranges. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment.

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers a competitive, comprehensive benefits package including health care benefits, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with an 8% employer match, parental leave, accrued paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, other life and work well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports of the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

Do you have military experience? Visit our U.S. Military Skills Translator to match your military experience with our current job openings!

TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

CoverMyMeds is seeking a Senior Manager, Data Governance to lead the implementation and ongoing operation of its data governance and data enablement capabilities. This leader will build and manage a team of domain data analysts and data stewards who support business domains by addressing data quality, lineage, metadata, catalog, and data product control needs.


This is a hands-on leadership opportunity within a developing data governance function. You will translate governance strategies, policies, and standards into practical services that help teams understand, manage, and improve their data. Success requires data governance expertise, service-oriented leadership, strong change-management skills, and the ability to influence partners without relying on formal authority.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and develop a team of domain data analysts and data stewards responsible for the day-to-day implementation of data governance and data quality controls
  • Implement and maintain the CoverMyMeds data enablement framework, including policies, standards, and procedures for data management, data quality, lineage, metadata, and responsible data use
  • Operationalize data governance capabilities across data quality, business and technical metadata, data lineage, data cataloging, and data product controls.
  • Partner with domain data officers, data owners, enterprise architecture, IT security, legal, compliance, and technology teams to establish accountability and embed governance practices into business operations
  • Align data analysts and stewards with business domains, enabling them to develop subject-matter expertise and serve as a first point of contact for data-related issues
  • Guide the identification, assessment, prioritization, and remediation of data quality issues in partnership with data owners and technology teams.
  • Define and monitor data enablement metrics and key performance indicators to evaluate program effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Drive adoption and change by communicating the value of new data governance services, building cross-functional support, and helping teams succeed in a developing operating model.
  • Promote compliance with applicable data privacy requirements and internal data security policies, including considerations related to GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA.
  • Coach and support team members through clear goals, ongoing feedback, collaborative problem-solving, and a service-oriented leadership approach

Basic Requirements:

  • Degree or equivalent experience, and typically requires 9+ years of relative professional experience and 1+ years of supervisory and/or management experience
  • Experience implementing or operating data governance, data management, or data enablement programs in a complex organization
  • Knowledge of data governance principles and practices, including data quality, metadata management, data lineage, data cataloging, and data stewardship
  • Experience leading people, teams, or cross-functional initiatives, including situations requiring influence without direct authority
  • Experience partnering with business and technology stakeholders to translate data governance policies and standards into operational processes
  • Demonstrated communication and change-management skills, including the ability to build understanding and adoption of new capabilities
  • Experience identifying, assessing, and coordinating the resolution of data quality or data management issues
  • Ability to analyze complex issues, establish priorities, and coordinate team activities to deliver practical solutions

Preferred Skills / Experience:

  • Familiarity with data governance frameworks and industry practices, such as DAMA-DMBOK
  • Experience using enterprise data catalogs such as Alation, Collibra, or IBM InfoSphere. CoverMyMeds currently uses Alation as its data catalog, while experience with comparable platforms is relevant
  • Familiarity with master data management concepts, frameworks, or technologies, including platforms from IBM or Informatica
  • Ability to read or interpret SQL and investigate data, metadata, or catalog information when hands-on support is needed
  • Experience working with healthcare, pharmaceutical, or similarly regulated data
  • Experience helping establish a new team, service, or operating model in a developing or greenfield environment

At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world-class programs and support every day.

Curriculum Associates is a mission-driven K–8 education company, and our leaders play a direct part in how we support educators and students. The Senior Executive Recruiter owns the search process for our most senior and business-critical roles, including Director, VP, and C-suite positions, as well as hard-to-fill specialized leadership roles.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will act as a strategic talent advisor to executives and hiring leaders, shaping search strategy, building relationships with leaders in and beyond education, and delivering an exceptional candidate experience that reflects our values.

The impact you’ll have:

Lead end-to-end executive searches

  • Own the full search lifecycle, from intake and role definition through sourcing, assessment, offer negotiation, and close
  • Partner with hiring executives to define success profiles, search criteria, and realistic timelines
  • Run confidential searches with discretion and sound judgment

Advise as a strategic talent partner

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and the executive team on leadership hiring, market trends, compensation benchmarks, and talent availability
  • Translate business strategy and workforce planning into clear executive talent plans
  • Provide candid guidance on search scope, candidate fit, and tradeoffs

Source and build executive talent pipelines

  • Develop proactive sourcing strategies to reach passive candidates, including leaders from education, ed-tech, and adjacent industries
  • Build and maintain a network of senior leaders, industry contacts, and external search partners
  • Maintain warm pipelines for anticipated future leadership needs

Assess and evaluate candidates

  • Conduct in-depth screening and structured interviews to evaluate leadership capability, mission alignment, and cultural contribution
  • Design and facilitate interview plans and panels that are consistent, fair, and evidence-based
  • Synthesize feedback and present clear, well-supported recommendations to decision makers

Drive an inclusive and equitable process

  • Build diverse slates and apply inclusive hiring practices throughout the search
  • Coach interviewers on bias awareness and structured evaluation
  • Help ensure every candidate is treated with respect and transparency

Negotiate and close

  • Partner with Total Rewards and HR leadership on offer structure, executive compensation, and equity considerations
  • Guide candidates through negotiation, relocation, and onboarding transitions
  • Support early-stage integration of new executives in partnership with HR and hiring leaders

Manage external search partners

  • Select, direct, and evaluate retained search firms when appropriate
  • Ensure external partners represent our brand and mission well and deliver quality results

Improve the executive hiring function

  • Contribute to the design of executive hiring standards, tools, and best practices
  • Track and report on search metrics, pipeline health, and quality of hire
  • Use applicant tracking system data and market intelligence to continuously improve outcomes
  • Mentor other recruiters and share executive search expertise across the Talent Acquisition team

Success in This Role Looks Like:

  • Senior leadership searches are filled with high-quality, mission-aligned leaders within agreed timelines
  • Hiring executives view you as a credible, strategic partner
  • Candidates, whether hired or not, describe a professional and respectful experience
  • Executive pipelines are strong, diverse, and ready ahead of need

What we’re looking for:

  • 10+ years of progressive recruiting experience, including 5+ years leading executive or senior leadership searches (Director, VP, and C-suite), in corporate talent acquisition, retained search, or both
  • Demonstrated track record of closing confidential, high-stakes searches and delivering high-quality hires within agreed timelines
  • Experience advising senior executives on search strategy, candidate assessment, market conditions, and executive compensation
  • Proven ability to source passive candidates and build executive networks through direct outreach, referrals, and relationship building
  • Skill in structured interviewing and leadership assessment, with the judgment to evaluate both capability and mission alignment
  • Experience negotiating complex executive offers, including base, incentive, equity, and relocation, in partnership with Total Rewards or HR
  • Experience building diverse candidate slates and applying inclusive, evidence-based hiring practices
  • Strong communication, discretion, and influencing skills, with credibility at the executive level
  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems and recruiting data, including pipeline and search metrics reporting

Benefits and Pay Range:

Pay Range – This role’s range is $93,250 - $166,250 The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that Curriculum Associates considers in making compensation decisions based on our Compensation Philosophy. Actual base pay within that range will vary based upon several factors including, but not limited to, prior experience and relevant skill sets. At Curriculum Associates, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances for each case. This role is also eligible to participate in the company bonus plan. The Company recognizes that minimum wage varies by location and will ensure all compensation decisions comply with applicable state and local laws.


Benefits – Benefit eligible employees (and their families) are covered by medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Employees can enroll in our company’s 401k plan and receive an employer match. Employees have access to a flexible vacation and sick policy in addition to twelve paid holidays and a winter office closure between Christmas and New Year's, as well as a number of additional perks and benefits.

Position Summary

WHO YOU ARE:

You are restless when a task shows up for the third time, curious about the story behind a number, and comfortable turning a vague question into something concrete, with AI as a trusted partner but your own judgment as the final check. You want your work to support the people who keep the food supply safe. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

WHO WE ARE:

• Leader in food safety solutions for both contract sanitation and chemistry in the food processing industry.

• Over 10,000 dedicated team members across North America.

• Corporate headquarters in Atlanta, GA with team members working in over 250 plants throughout North America.

• Over 50+ years of experience in creating long-lasting partnerships.

OUR MISSION:

We protect the food supply by eliminating risks so families everywhere can eat without fear.

  • Protect What Matters:We are in service of safety at every step, ensuring the health of everyone is central to all we do – from plant team members to consumers.
  • Deliver On Our Promises: We speak honestly and are dedicated to doing the right thing by upholding ethical standards and following through on our commitments to our teams, our customers, and our business.
  • Win as a Team: We believe in the power of collaboration, uniting our diverse strengths while working hand-in-hand with our team members and customers to unlock potential and achieve stronger results together.
  • Advance a Safer Future: We are committed to innovating more effective, sustainable, and cost-efficient food safety solutions to develop a safer world for all.
JOB DESCRIPTION

This role goes beyond traditional HR reporting. You will build the data infrastructure and AI-assisted workflows that empower HR, Safety, and Compliance leaders ask better questions and get faster, more trustworthy answers. Job duties include but are not limited to:

  • AI-Augmented Analysis:Use Claude and other AI tools to accelerate exploratory, draft and refine SQL/queries, identify trends across HRIS and workforce datasets, and validate findings before they reach leadership. Treat AI as a thinking partner that extends your perspective and capabilities, not a shortcut that replaces sound judgment.
  • Workflow & Automation Design: Identify repetitive, manual reporting processes and redesign them as automated, sustainable workflows — reducing turnaround time and freeing capacity for higher-value analysis. Build with reusability in mind so workflows outlast any single request.
  • Insight Engines, Not Just Reports:Move past static reporting toward systems that surface trends, anomalies, and "why" behind the numbers — proactively flagging issues in employee engagement, turnover, safety compliance, and workforce planning before they're asked about.
  • Data Integrity and Management:Ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness of HR data across HRIS, people management systems, and adjacent platforms. Conduct regular audits and build automated checks to catch discrepancies early.
  • Dashboards Built to Last:Design clear, visually compelling, and low-maintenance dashboards and reports (Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and AI-assisted tooling) that non-technical stakeholders can actually use — and that don't break the moment a data source shifts.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:Partner with HR, Compliance, Safety, Operations, Finance, and IT to understand reporting needs, align metrics to organizational goals, and translate ambiguous questions into concrete, buildable deliverables.
  • Continuous Improvement:Identify smarter ways to collect, model, and communicate data, and take ownership of implementing those improvements rather than just flagging them.
  • Special Projects: Contribute to experimental or exploratory initiatives — new metrics, predictive models, or AI tools — as assigned by leadership.


YOUR MUST HAVES:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Analytics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in HRIS platforms and reporting/BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Excel, SQL).
  • Demonstrated comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to support analysis, automate workflows, or accelerate reporting — and the judgment to know when to trust, verify, or override them.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex, sometimes messy data sets and translate findings into actionable insights.
  • A builder's mindset: you'd rather design a repeatable workflow than repeat manual work.
  • Genuine curiosity — you dig into anomalies instead of smoothing them over — paired with the creativity to present insights in ways that land with non-technical audiences.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to convey insights effectively to HR, Safety, and Compliance leadership.
  • Knowledge of HR metrics, workforce analytics, and compliance reporting.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work collaboratively across cross-functional teams.
  • High attention to detail and an unwavering commitment to data accuracy.

WHAT WE PREFER YOU HAVE:

  • Hands-on experience designing AI-assisted or automated reporting workflows (e.g., using Claude, Python, or low-code automation tools) in an HR or People Analytics context.
  • 3 or more years of related experience.
  • Experience with predictive analytics and HR data modeling.
  • Familiarity with machine learning concepts and emerging HR technology trends.
  • A track record of turning a one-off analysis request into a durable, self-serve tool or dashboard.
  • Certification in HR analytics, data visualization, or AI/prompt engineering tools is a plus.

CAS is currently seeking an Account Manager/Business Development Manager. This position will be remote.

This hybrid role combines account management, business development, and consultative solution selling to drive revenue growth and customer success across CAS’s portfolio, including Custom Services, IP Services, SciFinder, and STN.

The role is accountable for the profitable growth of existing accounts and acquisition of new business within an assigned North American territory. The successful candidate will leverage a strong understanding of chemistry-related domains and CAS capabilities to develop tailored, high-value solutions that address complex client needs.

This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to clients—engaging stakeholders including R&D, Law Firm Partners, Technology and AI Project Leads, Global Heads of IP and C-suite executives while collaborating internally to design and deliver differentiated, customer-centric solutions.

Account Management & Customer Growth

  • Build and maintain deep, multi-level relationships across customer organizations, including senior executives and day-to-day stakeholders
  • Cultivate and leverage relationships with decision makers, C-Suite executives to facilitate the management and growth of a portfolio of assigned accounts by driving retention, cross-sell, upsell, and expansion opportunities
  • Deliver exceptional customer experiences through regular engagement, proactive support, and strategic guidance
  • Monitor customer health, usage, and pipeline to identify risks and growth opportunities
  • Develop and communicate customer success stories and value realization outcomes

Business Development & Pipeline Generation

  • Develop and execute a territory sales strategy to generate short- and long-term revenue growth.
  • Proactively prospect into target accounts via networking, outreach, and collaboration with internal sales teams
  • Identify, qualify, and advance opportunities into a robust, high-quality sales pipeline
  • Lead and develop agreements, evaluation RFPs, prepare RFP responses, written proposals, price to win strategies, and contract negotiations
  • Attend and represent CAS at industry events, trade shows, and networking forums

Solution Selling & Client Engagement

  • Conduct thorough needs assessments to uncover client challenges and align them with CAS offerings

  • Partner with internal subject matter experts and delivery teams to design and execute customized engagements

Collaboration & Market Intelligence

  • Collaborate with marketing and product teams to promote CAS capabilities and refine go-to-market strategies

  • Strong consultative selling skills with experience delivering complex, solution-based offerings
  • Ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels, including C-suite executives

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills

raw.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.


Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.


Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.


As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.


We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.


We’re transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics — including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data — accessible to every collector, old or new. Our engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization. We're seeking engineers to utilize advanced technology in agile settings, with a focus on improving the customer experience for every collector.


Collectors Cybersecurity team is committed to utilize cybersecurity, risk and privacy best practices on our platforms, leveraging signal intelligence and observability at scale to protect our customers, employees and our brand.


We’re looking for a Security Operations Engineer to join our Cybersecurity team to partner with the broader Product and Tech org and drive secure by default architectures and ensure the security and integrity of our infrastructure.

You’ll join our Cybersecurity Team and work from our Santa Ana, CA office. Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered. We believe that there is significant value in in-person collaboration. If you live within a 1 hour commuting distance to one of our offices, you will be required to be onsite most of the time. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process.



What You’ll Do:



  • Drive Detection Engineering: Build, tune and manage high-confidence detections across cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), enterprise tooling (Okta, GWS, M365) and vendor products. Treat detections as code: version controlled, peer reviewed, tested in CI, and measured for precision and coverage against MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Incident Command and Containment: Serve as a senior responder for security incidents, driving triage, containment, forensics, and remediation, and authoring post-incident reviews that turn lessons into durable improvements.
  • Threat Hunting: Conduct proactive threat hunts across cloud, SaaS, identity and on-prem infrastructure, converting hypotheses and findings into new detections and hardened controls.
  • Tooling and Response Automation: Design and build automation and SOAR playbooks that reduce manual toil, accelerate response times, and improve alert enrichment and case management.
  • Security Telemetry: Own and improve the health of the security data pipeline: log source onboarding, parser and schema quality, coverage gap analysis, and data quality for data sources across our cloud, SaaS and on-prem environment.
  • Automated Analysis and Secure Frameworks: Scale security efforts by integrating automation for the identification, prioritization, and remediation of vulnerabilities
  • Partner cross-functionally with infrastructure, platform, and engineering teams to embed security operations requirements into new services and cloud architecture decisions.
  • Lead by example and be a champion of all company policies, including safety, attendance & security
  • Participate in a shared on-call rotation, and continuously improve runbooks, escalation paths, and alert quality to make on-call sustainable for the whole team.



Who You Are:



  • 5+ years in security operations, incident response, or detection engineering, with at least 2 years operating in a cloud-native environment at a senior level.
  • Deep hands-on experience securing AWS at scale (IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, EC2/EKS/Lambda) in a multi-account organization; familiarity with GCP or Azure is a plus.
  • Strong SIEM proficiency - you've built and tuned detections, written complex queries, and managed log pipelines, not just consumed alerts.
  • Proficiency in one or more general purpose programming/script languages, preferably Python, and comfortable building automation, integrations, and SOAR playbooks from scratch.
  • A seasoned incident responder who stays calm under pressure, communicates clearly with technical and executive audiences, and leads without needing formal authority.
  • Grounded in attacker tradecraft - you think in terms of MITRE ATT&CK, understand cloud-specific attack paths, and use that lens to prioritize work.
  • Experienced working across team boundaries: influencing engineering roadmaps, negotiating with vendors, and representing security operations in cross-functional forums.
  • Pragmatic and outcome-driven - you balance ideal security posture against operational reality and know when good enough today beats perfect next quarter.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and handle multiple tasks
  • Familiarity with major compliance frameworks, such as PCI, NIST, ISO, SOX, and experience assisting in audits

Salary Range:The salary range for this position is $140,971- $228,870. Actual compensation on this range varies based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors, including location, job level, experience, and skill set.   • Additional Benefits:Full-time employees are eligible for fertility, commuter, and educational assistance benefits.

raw.description:
About the Role

We are hiring a Manager, Cloud Platform Engineers to lead our India-based platform and automation engineering staff. This is a people-management role with real technical ownership -- you will be evaluated as much on your ability to review and stand behind your team's Kubernetes and Terraform work as on how you manage the people producing it. You will oversee day-to-day execution of AKS operations and Terraform-based automation, working in close coordination with the US-based Principal and Expert Platform Engineers who set the platform's architectural direction.

This role exists to provide direct, hands-on management and accurate technical oversight of the India-based team -- including work planning, prioritization, quality review, and status reporting to the Senior Manager, Cloud Platform. Reporting must reflect verified, actual system state; this is a core expectation of the role, not a formality.


What You'll Do

  • Directly manage India-based Cloud Platform engineers, including workload assignment, prioritization, and day-to-day people management.
  • Review and stand behind your team's Terraform module submissions and AKS configuration changes for correctness, adherence to documented standards, and production-readiness before they are considered complete.
  • Enforce engineering process standards across the team: issue-based work tracking, triage and prioritization before work begins, work-in-progress limits, and daily status updates.
  • Provide the Senior Manager, Cloud Platform with accurate, verified status reporting on the India-based team's work -- cross-checked against actual system and repository state, not summarized from memory or secondhand updates.
  • Coordinate with the Principal and Expert Platform Engineers on platform architecture and standards, ensuring the India-based team's work aligns with the broader platform's GitOps, Terraform, and AKS conventions.
  • Escalate technical or delivery risks early and directly, rather than allowing status to be discovered after the fact.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, and skill development for the India-based team, including closing gaps in Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD fundamentals where needed.
  • Apply policy-as-code and security standards already established on the platform (Kyverno or equivalent) when reviewing team output.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years in platform, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering roles, including some prior people-management or formal technical-lead experience.
  • Hands-on production experience with Kubernetes, ideally AKS specifically -- sufficient to personally review a team member's cluster or workload change and identify problems.
  • Working Terraform experience, including the ability to review a submitted module for correctness, reusability, and adherence to documented standards.
  • GitOps experience (ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent) -- all infrastructure and cluster changes should trace to a git commit as a matter of practice, not preference.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce accurate, verifiable status reporting to senior leadership.
  • Experience managing engineers directly, including performance management, prioritization, and workload planning.
  • Working fluency in policy-as-code tooling (Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, or equivalent).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing a distributed or offshore engineering team reporting to a manager in a different region.
  • Practical, current experience using AI-assisted development tools in daily engineering work.
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, or equivalent).
  • Background modernizing legacy automation (PowerShell or similar) toward Terraform or platform-native replacements.
