raw.excerpt: Job Description: We are Omnissa!  Omnissa is the first AI-driven digital work platform, built to support flexible, secure, work-from anywhere experiences.
raw.description:
Job Description:

We are Omnissa! 

Omnissa is the first AI-driven digital work platform, built to support flexible, secure, work-from anywhere experiences. We integrate industry-leading solutions —including Unified Endpoint Management, Windows Modern Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security & Compliance— into a seamless, autonomous workspace that adapts to how people work. Our platform boosts employee engagement while optimizing IT operations, security, and cost.

Guided by our Core Values—Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency, and Maximize Customer Value—we’re growing rapidly and committed to delivering meaningful impact. If you're passionate about shaping the future of work, we’d love to hear from you.

What is the opportunity?


At Omnissa, we are committed to maintaining a fair, consistent, and secure hiring process for all candidates. As part of this approach, we use standard interview and verification practices designed to ensure alignment and protect both candidates and the organization. These practices are applied thoughtfully and with respect for candidate privacy.

As a Professional Services Senior Architect, you will be responsible for leading the implementation and championing the adoption of solutions purchased by our most important and largest customers daily. You will gather and analyze customer requirements to create an architectural design consisting of compute infrastructure planning (private and public cloud), recommending and planning configurations, validating deployment, enhancing operations strategy, and increasing user adoption. You will serve as a trusted advisor to our customers, developing an intimate knowledge of their business and strategic goals and use your in-depth knowledge of the Omnissa Workspace ONE Platform to work with customers on building successful implementation and adoption roadmaps and driving the vision to completion.

You will have opportunities to solve customers’ challenges and deliver secure digital workspaces with Omnissa Workspace ONE while being a part of a team of overachievers, highly successful individuals. Here is a breakdown:

  • During your first month, you will work with a mentor and your peers to gain familiarity with our internal processes. In the context of customer engagements, they will help you gain insight and experience to ensure the solution being delivered is fit for purpose through referencing the initial business goals and objectives, demonstrating commercial and scope awareness, and understanding the wider technical landscape and how it relates to/integrates with customer environments.
  • Your manager, mentor, and peers will help you gain access to other important internal stakeholders to help you establish your network of contacts across different Omnissa business units to make you successful.
  • Within your first three months, you will be expected to take full ownership of business outcomes, lead technical project teams, and take accountability for all project deliverables—further developing your leadership, technical, and business process skills.
  • Following onboarding, you will transition into one or many customer engagements, depending on business need. As an Omnissa Professional Services Senior Architect, you will lead the implementation and adoption activities of Omnissa Workspace ONE solutions for our customers. By combining your unique leadership skills with your technical acumen, you will lead our customers to achieving their business goals. You won’t do it alone: You will always have the help of your team as you progress and develop your skills.
  • You will use your in-depth knowledge of Omnissa and adjacent products to become a trusted advisor to your customers and colleagues. Your passion for technology makes you uniquely capable of earning and maintaining subject-matter expertise in the innovative field of end-user computing.

What will you bring to Omnissa?

  • This is a consulting position where you will be using technical, consulting, business, and leadership skills. You will work directly with our customers and other Omnissa employees on the day-to-day activities involved with the post-sales implementation of Omnissa Workspace ONE. You will articulate solution designs, integrating both technical and business concepts, and present a transformational journey to project stakeholders. Your goal is to lead the customers through their journey to successfully adopt our platforms for their end users. You will manage customer expectations and work with Project Managers to create project plans with realistic workstream timelines.
  • You will interact with various customers’ teams, from technical engineers and system administrators to business leaders and executives. Those teams often don’t work so closely together, and it’s on you to help them come together. You will communicate effectively to all audiences—this is key to the success of your projects.
  • We can’t improve without continuously evolving our methodologies, tools, and services. We will count on you to challenge existing delivery processes and identify customer trends in end-user computing to assist in developing go-to-market strategies and new or revised services offerings.
  • You will be successful even faster if you have knowledge of other adjacent technologies such as Omnissa Horizon, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Intune and SCCM, Okta, EntraID, as well as in depth knowledge of operating systems management for Windows 11, MacOS, iOS, and Android.

Location: United States
Location Type: REMOTE / HYBRID for Atlanta residents
Travel Expectations: As needed depending on customer demand. Usually, we experience low travel needs (less than 3 times per quarter). Most travel will be two to four days out of the week.
Education: Technology related 4-year degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

The typical base salary for this role is between USD $160,000 – $200,000 per year and it may be eligible for participation in a corporate bonus program. Actual compensation offer may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, skill level, or other relevant factors. In addition to competitive compensation, Omnissa offers a variety of benefits such as employee ownership, health insurance, 401k with matching contributions, disability insurance, paid-time off, growth opportunities, and more.

Omnissa is an Equal Employment Opportunity company and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind:

Omnissa is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity and to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Omnissa are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, ancestry, ethnicity, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past, present, or prospective service in the uniformed services, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Omnissa will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Omnissa welcomes applicants of all ages. Omnissa will provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees who have protected disabilities consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

This job requisition is not eligible for employment-based immigration sponsorship by Omnissa.

raw.title: Initiativbewerbung (m/w/d)
raw.excerpt: Was uns ausmacht3A ist eine führende Unternehmensberatung für die Versicherungsbranche.
raw.description:
Was uns ausmacht

3A ist eine führende Unternehmensberatung für die Versicherungsbranche. Seit über 20 Jahren sind wir erfolgreich und wurden mehrfach ausgezeichnet, unter anderem von Handelsblatt, brand eins und Statista als eine der besten Unternehmensberatungen sowie von Kununu als Top Company. Als partnergeführtes Team verbinden wir Stabilität mit der Flexibilität und Kreativität moderner Beratung.

Unsere Kultur lebt von Offenheit, Vertrauen und dem Mut, neue Wege zu gehen. Mit Strategie, Ideenreichtum und Teamgeist treiben wir interdisziplinäre Projekte voran und erzielen partnerschaftlich messbare Erfolge. Wir arbeiten nach den Standards des „Erfolgsfaktor Familie“ und unterstützen Dich dabei, Beruf und persönliche Lebensphasen zu vereinen. Bei uns profitierst Du von hoher Selbstorganisation, individueller Weiterentwicklung und flexiblem Homeoffice.

Warum eine Initiativbewerbung bei 3A?

Du möchtest die Versicherungsbranche aktiv mitgestalten, Verantwortung übernehmen und Deine Expertise in anspruchsvolle Projekte einbringen? Auch wenn aktuell keine Stelle exakt zu Deinem Profil ausgeschrieben ist, sind wir immer offen für engagierte Persönlichkeiten, die fachlich wie menschlich zu uns passen.

Ob Prozessberatung, Digitalisierung, strategische Konzepte oder Projektleitung: Wir freuen uns über Initiativbewerbungen von Beratern, die gemeinsam mit uns wachsen möchten.

Aufgaben

– je nach Profil:

In Beratungsprojekten:

  • Prozess- und Organisationsberatung:
    Du analysierst, optimierst und implementierst Geschäftsprozesse in der Versicherungswirtschaft. Dabei liegt Dein Fokus auf Digitalisierung, Automatisierung, Customer Experience, Workflow-Optimierung und der Einführung agiler Organisationsstrukturen.
  • Eigenverantwortliche Projektleitung:
    Du übernimmst die Leitung von Projekten oder Teilprojekten, steuerst Zeitpläne, Qualität und Budget und sorgst dafür, dass Ergebnisse zuverlässig umgesetzt werden.
  • Strategische Beratung:
    Du begleitest unsere Kunden bei der Entwicklung zukunftsweisender Konzepte, die ihre Geschäftsmodelle stärken und langfristigen Erfolg sichern.

Intern bei 3A:

  • Innovations- und Geschäftsentwicklung:
    Du entwickelst innovative Lösungen, identifizierst neue Chancen und gestaltest aktiv unser Beratungsportfolio mit, um unsere Kunden zukunftsorientiert zu unterstützen.
  • Netzwerkpflege:
    Du baust nachhaltige Beziehungen zu Kunden, Partnern und internen Stakeholdern auf und pflegst Dein berufliches Netzwerk langfristig.
  • Interne Mitwirkung:
    Du bringst Dich aktiv in interne Entscheidungsprozesse ein und unterstützt das Team bei strategischen, organisatorischen und operativen Themen.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung & Studium:
    Du hast eine Ausbildung als Versicherungskaufmann/-frau abgeschlossen und/oder ein Studium mit Bezug zur Versicherungswirtschaft, z. B. in Versicherungswesen, BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar.
  • Berufserfahrung:
    Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im Versicherungsumfeld, idealerweise in Unternehmensberatung, Projektleitung oder Transformationsprojekten.
  • Fachliche Kompetenz:
    Du verstehst Versicherungsprozesse, hast ein Gespür für Effizienzsteigerung und Digitalisierung und bringst Kenntnisse in Geschäftsprozessmanagement oder verwandten Methoden mit.
  • Selbstständigkeit & Eigeninitiative:
    Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst eigene Ideen aktiv ein.
  • Empathie & Beratungskompetenz:
    Du berätst partnerschaftlich auf Augenhöhe, erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse und baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf.
  • Teamfähigkeit & Verantwortung:
    Du arbeitest gerne im Team, genießt Gestaltungsspielraum und übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Projekte und Ergebnisse.
  • Digitale Kompetenz:
    Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office sowie digitalen Tools für Projektmanagement und Präsentationen.
  • Flexibilität & Mobilität:
    Du bist bereit, bei Bedarf zu Kunden zu reisen und schätzt die Möglichkeit bis zu 100% remote zu arbeiten.

Benefits

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Arbeite genau dort, wo Du am produktivsten bist. Ob im Homeoffice, unterwegs oder zeitweise im europäischen Ausland. Teilzeitmodelle sind ebenfalls möglich.
  • Freizeit & Erholung: Genieße 30 Tage Urlaub plus zusätzliche freie Tage und Sonderurlaub für besondere Anlässe. Und wenn Du länger auftanken möchtest, stehen Dir Sabbatical- und Workation-Möglichkeiten offen.
  • Teamkultur: Dich erwartet eine offene, herzliche Atmosphäre mit regelmäßigen Teamevents, After-Work-Angeboten und gemeinsamen Aktivitäten mit Kollegen und Familie.
  • Individuelle Weiterentwicklung: Wir fördern Deinen persönlichen und fachlichen Wachstumspfad mit maßgeschneiderten Trainings, Mentoring und klaren Entwicklungsperspektiven.
  • Work-Life-Balance: Beruf und Familie lassen sich bei uns gut vereinbaren. Wir bieten ein Umfeld, in dem persönliche Belange ernst genommen werden.
  • Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden: Bleib fit und ausgeglichen mit unserem vielfältigen Angebot für körperliches und mentales Wohlbefinden. Wir unterstützen Dich mit Programmen wie EGYM Wellpass.
  • Mobilität & Extras: Profitiere von flexibler Mobilität mit JobRad-Leasing und attraktiven Zusatzleistungen von Corporate Benefits.
  • Vorsorge: Mit betrieblicher Altersvorsorge, Gruppenunfallversicherung und weiteren Schutzleistungen bist Du langfristig bestens abgesichert.

Dein nächster Schritt

Du hast Lust, Deine Erfahrung einzubringen und gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Versicherungsbranche zu gestalten?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Initiativbewerbung und darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Join a team that puts its People First! As a member of the First American family of companies, First American Trust is a federal savings bank that has provided banking, wealth management, and trust solutions on a national, full-service basis for more than five decades. Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

What We Do

Establish, build, and maintain mutually beneficial relationships with assigned Trust Accounting clients. Provide full-service reconciliation (from 1st tier/routine to 2nd tier/complex) to our escrow and title partners focusing on complex customer issues. Analyze customer needs, identify problems, research issues, and recommend solutions.

What You'll Do:

  • Compare financial records: Reconciliation specialists examine a company's escrow accounting records, such as ledgers and bank statements, to ensure they match
  • Identify discrepancies: They look for any inconsistencies or errors between different financial sources
  • Investigate and resolve: When discrepancies are found, they investigate the causes and work with clients to resolve them
  • Ensure accuracy: Their primary goal is to maintain the integrity and accuracy of financial data

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 5-7 years of directly relevant reconciliation, accounting, or audit work experience, mortgage or title insurance industry preferred
  • Proficient in Microsoft applications (Word, Outlook, Excel) and demonstrate the ability to learn custom applications
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
  • Knowledge of accounting principles
  • Experience with financial software
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively



Pay Range: $64,300.00 - $85,700.00 AnnuallyThis hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location.

** Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County. **

First American will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (e.g., the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act).

First American intends to conduct a review of an applicant’s criminal history in connection with a conditional offer. First American reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following material job duties for this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: handling of confidential, proprietary or trade secret information belonging to First American or its customers, administrating or facilitating financial transactions, and the ability to meet customer-imposed criminal history requirements.

What We Offer

By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees - not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term.Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.

raw.description:
Overview

Company Overview:

Join Allied Universal® Technology Services, a global leader in transforming the security industry. We integrate advanced technology — video surveillance, electronic access control, alarm monitoring and augmented solutions with physical security to help people feel safe. Whether you’re an installation technician, service technician, engineer, or project manager, you’ll discover rewarding opportunities to grow your career as part of a valued team.

Apply today and be phenomenal—build a meaningful career while protecting what matters most through innovative security technology.

Job Description

Allied Universal® Technology Services is seeking an Enterprise Account Executive (EAE) who will be essential in the achievement of enterprise sales goals by driving new business development within prospective and assigned accounts. The Account Executive will represent Allied Universal® Technology Services' core values through a consultative approach with clients and internal & external partners.

Why Join Allied Universal® Technology Services?

  • Opportunity to work with industry-leading security technology
  • Career growth in a fast-paced, innovative environment

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Business Development: Create and execute growth plans within prospective and designated accounts, aiming to expand Allied Universal® Technology Services' market share within new and existing captured / assigned accounts
  • Account Management: Foster consultative relationships with clients, partners, and stakeholders for sustained business growth while collaborating with Project Managers to ensure consistent service delivery
  • Sales Process Management: Oversee the full sales cycle, from managing company provided leads / accounts to proposal, pricing, contract negotiation, tailored presentations, and post-close implementation
  • Goal Achievement: Consistently exceed sales targets by driving new business within assigned accounts, increasing project support and service offerings with current customers and partnering with the Director of Strategic Solutions for cross selling opportunities with assigned physical security guarding clients
  • Solution Presentation: Deliver presentations of Allied Universal® Technology Services' security solutions, including installation, service, maintenance agreements, and hosted managed services
  • Efficient Scheduling: Strategically manage travel and appointments to maximize client interactions
  • Market Awareness: Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging technologies to uncover new business opportunities
  • Performance Reporting: Track and report on sales pipeline and goal progress through CRM and regular updates to senior management

Cultural Fit: Join a team that prioritizes innovation, agility, and collaboration

QUALIFICATIONS (MUST HAVE)

  • Must possess one or more of the following:
    • Bachelor’s degree or a related field with at least three (3) years of outside sales experience in a Business-to-Business environment selling a technical solution
    • Associate’s degree or a related with at least five (5) years of outside sales experience in a Business-to-Business environment selling a technical solution
    • High School diploma with at least ten (10) years of outside sales experience in a Business-to-Business environment
  • Current driver’s license if driving a company vehicle or personal vehicle while conducting business (e.g., client visits, attending networking events)
  • Results-Driven: Award-winning, consultative sales professional with a proven record of exceeding goals
  • Relationship Builder: Experienced in developing long-term client relationships and delivering high-quality service
  • Organized & Strategic: Skilled in planning for cold calling, client meetings and site walks throughout the territory while consistently reporting on goal tracking and achievement
  • Exceptional Communicator: Strong interpersonal and presentation skills, adept at crafting compelling presentations and written communications
  • Brand Builder: Experienced in brand development using networks, associations, and social media for effective prospecting
  • Multi-Tasker: Capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, with excellent follow-up skills.
  • Tech-Savvy: Proficient in Salesforce and MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and ability to learn and present comprehensive technology product and service solutions to our clients

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with electronic security platforms such as AMAG, Lenel-S2, Genetec, Avigilon, and others.
  • Familiarity with SAP and WeEstimate or similar quoting tools.

BENEFITS:

  • Pay: $90,000.00 - $100,000.00 + auto allowance + gas card + uncapped commission plan
  • Medical, dental, vision, retirement plan, basic life, AD&D, and disability insurance
  • Eight paid holidays annually, five sick days, and four personal days
  • Vacation time is offered at an accrual rate of 3.08 hours biweekly. Unused vacation is only paid out where required by law.

Closing

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com

This is a remote position.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?
We are seeking a Salesforce Experience Cloud Developer to support our client’s Salesforce platform, and Marketing Cloud. You'll play a key part in optimizing user experience, performance, and scalability for business-critical applications while driving innovation in a collaborative, high-impact role.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Reporting to our Delivery Operations Manager, as a Full-Time Specialist on our team, you will work remotely to support daily operations and ongoing enhancements for our client’s various platforms, including Salesforce, a Knowledge Sharing Portal, and public websites. The goal is to improve the overall user experience, maintainability, and functionality of these business applications. Our client’s environment includes Salesforce Services and Marketing Cloud.

QUALIFICATIONS:
  • 3+ years of experience with Salesforce Lightning and Salesforce front-end development.
  • Experience working with Salesforce Experience Cloud and integrating user-facing components with CRM workflows and business processes.
  • Solid understanding of UX/UI design principles, web standards, and best practices in front-end development (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript).
  • Experience with responsive design, mobile-first development, and ensuring accessibility (WCAG compliance).
  • Strong collaboration skills, especially in an Agile environment, with experience working across multiple teams (e.g., developers, designers, business analysts).
RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Update and maintain user interfaces, workflows, and the overall user experience within the Salesforce platform, focusing on high-quality, responsive design.
  • Develop, customize, and enhance Salesforce applications using Lightning components and other declarative tools, such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, including business analysts, Salesforce administrators, back-end developers, and UI/UX designers to gather requirements for new features and enhancements, ensuring alignment with business needs.
  • Ensure that all interfaces adhere to accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) and are optimized for cross-browser compatibility.
  • Perform unit testing, debugging, and troubleshooting to ensure the quality and stability of developed solutions.
  • Stay updated with Salesforce platform updates, new features, and industry trends, and evaluate their potential impact on the organization.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to front-end performance, usability, and browser inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support system upgrades, releases, and patches, and provide post-implementation support.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and methodologies to enhance efficiency and maintainability.
WHAT WE OFFER:
Celebrated by Inc. 5000 for our rapid growth and award-winning workplace, Main Digital invites you to be a part of our collaborative and forward-thinking team. As a Certified Women-Owned Small Business, we champion diversity in tech. Our diverse teams combine management consulting expertise, innovative digital design, and advanced product engineering. Driven by our six core values, we lead in intelligent automation, platform technologies, and Agile methodologies to create unparalleled digital experiences. Join us as we empower people to create new possibilities through process and technology, reimagining the ways of work and enhancing experiences with digital transformation.
Ready to innovate? Explore a career offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and extensive development opportunities. Apply today and shape the future with us!
Main Digital is committed to the principles of equal employment. We are committed to complying with all federal, state, and local laws providing equal employment opportunities, and all other employment laws and regulations. It is our intent to maintain a work environment that is free of harassment, discrimination, or retaliation because of age, race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation (including transgender status, gender identity or expression), pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation, and related medical conditions), reproductive health decisions, marital status, personal appearance, matriculation, political affiliation, credit information, employment status, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), veteran status, uniformed service member status, status as a victim or family member of a victim of domestic violence, a sexual offense, or stalking, homeless status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local laws.

raw.excerpt: About Paper Paper is reimagining how schools support students so that every learner can reach their full potential.
raw.description:
About Paper

Paper is reimagining how schools support students so that every learner can reach their full potential. Our vision is a world where every student receives timely, personalized, and relevant academic support. We offer a suite of scalable solutions including 24/7 tutoring, writing feedback, math practice, college and career support, and AI-powered instructional tools that provide personalized support to all students, including multilingual learners. Our GROW high-impact tutoring program accelerates learning through targeted small-group instruction, delivers measurable gains in student achievement, and eases teacher workloads. Trusted by 500+ school districts across 40+ states and backed by leading investors including IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Framework Capital, and Reach Capital, we’re pursuing a bold goal: to drive the best academic outcomes for as many students as possible.

About the role

Members of Paper's sales team must be both tenacious and emotionally intelligent in their approach to cultivating customer interest and new business opportunities. Our Account Executives (a.k.a. customer-facing Partnership Managers) will write compelling prospecting emails, and follow up with insightful phone interactions, to ensure Paper understands and can meet each prospect's unique goals and needs. The ultimate goal is to produce valuable partnerships that benefit Paper, the customer, and education as a whole. Success is measured through revenue booked from new sales.

We maintain this role as an evergreen opportunity, so qualified candidates are encouraged to apply at any time.​

We are currently prioritizing on applicants who have experience covering western USA/California as their assigned territory.

What you'll do

  • Articulate the GROW by Paper value proposition, to assess customer goals, needs, and buying interest.
  • Create a positive first impression with our prospects and customers by providing them with a world-class experience.
  • Send precisely written business emails, and conduct highly effective follow-up phone calls, on a daily basis.
  • Qualify sales opportunities by prospecting.
  • Overcome customer objections to generate quality opportunities.
  • Consistently achieve individual and team quotas and KPIs.
  • Work closely with the Marketing and Customer Success teams to establish ways to improve our sales strategy and execution.

Qualifications

  • Excellent written/verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to understand customer needs and meet that need with successful product sales.
  • Public speaking & presentation skills.
  • K12 edtech selling experience
  • Experience working with a quota and commission plan.
  • Teamwork oriented with comfort being both a leader and a support member.
  • Strong listening skills and ability to understand unique customer problems
  • Strong problem solving skills.
  • Motivation, driven and a self-starting attitude.
  • Ability to work in a fast paced, team environment.
  • Ability to multitask, take initiative, prioritize, and manage time effectively.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with instructional/academic solutions
  • Track record of success in personal endeavors.
  • Familiarity with CRM software.

This role is eligible to participate in our commission and equity plans. Please note that the final offer amount is determined by multiple factors, including geographic location as well as candidate experience, and may vary from the amounts listed above​.

What is it like to work at Paper? You will:

  • Be joining a remote-first company with a collaborative, mission-driven culture working together to write the next chapter of Paper!
  • Have opportunities to connect in person throughout the year, even while working remotely day-to-day.
  • Be part of an exciting new era of growth, with fresh leadership, a bold product vision, and a redefined charter.
  • Thrive in a fast-moving, build-from-scratch environment where agility and critical thinking guide decisions, collaboration is built on trust and healthy challenge, and every team member takes ownership to deliver real customer impact and grow every day.

Additional Benefits:

  • Comprehensive & competitive compensation, health benefits, retirement plan, stock options, and more.
  • In addition to vacation days, we provide Paperites with sick days and 4 extra weeks off - including statutory holidays, Paper Days throughout the year, and a full Paper Week from Dec 25 to Jan 1.
  • A $500 stipend to set-up your workspace and $100 monthly stipends to support with on-going workspace needs.
  • We support growing families with generous paid parental leave.
  • Unlimited access to tutoring and educational support for children of Paper employees.

You’ll be joining a team of mission-driven builders who care deeply about equity in education, and who thrive in a culture of ownership, velocity, and continuous learning. raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Actuary, Pricing will play a key role in developing and executing pricing strategies for Medicare Advantage products. You will establish pricing assumptions, prepare and submit bids, supports regulatory rate filings and certifications, and help implement rates, new plans, and benefit changes. You will also advise Product Development on the cost impact of new products and benefits while developing and maintaining tools for pricing both standard and customized offerings. This role addresses a broad range of moderately to highly complex actuarial challenges and requires strong analytical judgment and cross-functional collaboration.

The Actuary, Pricing will report to the Director, Actuarial Pricing. You will establish market-level financial metrics aligned with segment profitability goals, analyze results and projections, and recommend pricing actions to address gaps in targeted performance. You will manage forecasting cycles aligned with government-established timelines. Using market projections and experience-data tools, you will identify root causes and develop actionable insights.

The Actuary, Pricing also monitors the competitive landscape and collaborates with market partners to create strategies that support profitable membership growth. You will be accountable for actuarial certifications related to rate filings, including attesting to compliance with state and federal rating and benefit regulations. In addition, the Actuary, Pricing advises executives on significant, often segment-specific functional strategies.


Use your skills to make an impact

  • Experience in more than two functions (e.g., modeling, pricing, rate filing, reporting & analysis, reserving or trending)

Additional Information

In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$129,300 - $177,800 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 10-21-2026

description: Job Description: The Elevator Pitch: Why will you enjoy this new opportunity?

raw.title: Customer Success Manager
raw.excerpt: Job Description: The Elevator Pitch: Why will you enjoy this new opportunity?
raw.description:
Job Description:

The Elevator Pitch: Why will you enjoy this new opportunity?


At Omnissa, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact while working alongside a global community of passionate professionals shaping the future of digital work. The EUC Customer Success Manager plays a critical role in accelerating Omnissa's growth by helping customers successfully adopt, expand, and realize measurable business value from Omnissa solutions. As a trusted advisor, you will partner with customers throughout their lifecycle, helping them achieve business outcomes, improve employee experience, increase operational efficiency, and maximize return on investment. Every day is different as you build strategic relationships, advocate for customers, and collaborate across Sales, Support, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, and Renewals teams.


Success in the Role: What are the performance outcomes over the first 90 days you will work toward completing?


30 Days

  • Develop relationships with key stakeholders across assigned accounts and internal account teams.
    • Build an understanding of Omnissa solutions, services, customer journeys, and success methodologies.
    • Learn Customer Success tools, health metrics, engagement models, and internal processes.
    • Understand customer objectives, strategic priorities, adoption goals, and success criteria.
    • Facilitate effective communication between customers and cross-functional teams.

60 Days:

  • Manage a portfolio of customers with varying business objectives and maturity levels.
    • Build and maintain business outcome-focused Success Plans.
    • Conduct regular customer engagements, value discussions, and adoption reviews.
    • Serve as the voice of the customer and promote industry best practices internally.
    • Identify risks, opportunities, and adoption barriers while creating mitigation plans.

    90 Days:
    • Drive measurable improvements in customer health, adoption, retention, and business value realization.
    • Manage multi-level stakeholder engagement from administrators through executive sponsors.
    • Lead Executive Business Reviews aligned to customer strategic priorities.
    • Identify growth, expansion, and cross-solution adoption opportunities.
    • Contribute to Customer Success playbooks, customer references, success plans, case studies, and thought leadership.

What type of work will you be doing?


Customer Success & Business Outcomes

  • Maximize customer value realization and adoption of Omnissa solutions.
    • Develop and manage Customer Success Plans aligned to measurable business outcomes.
    • Monitor customer health indicators and proactively address risks.
    • Drive utilization, consumption, and achievement of desired outcomes.

    Executive Engagement & Strategic Advisory
    • Build strategic relationships with business decision makers and executive stakeholders.
    • Deliver business and technical presentations from practitioner through executive level audiences.
    • Lead Executive Business Reviews focused on value realization, ROI, adoption, and future roadmaps.
    • Provide strategic guidance and industry best practices.

Retention & Growth

  • Support customer retention through proactive engagement and value realization.
    • Identify expansion, cross-sell, and broader platform adoption opportunities.
    • Partner with Sales and Renewals teams to support long-term customer success.

    Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Collaborate with Support, Engineering, Product Management, Sales, Services, and Solution Architects.
    • Ensure customer issues are addressed in a timely manner.
    • Advocate for customer needs and influence product improvements.

    Customer Advocacy
    • Drive customer references, success stories, advisory boards, and advocacy programs.
    • Help develop roadmaps aligned to customer business priorities.
    • Contribute to thought leadership and Customer Success best practices.

    Travel may be required up to 20% depending on customer and business needs.

Required Qualifications & Skills


  • Experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, Professional Services, or related customer-facing roles.
    • Proven success managing enterprise and strategic customer relationships.
    • Strong executive presence, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
    • Ability to align technology capabilities to business outcomes.
    • Experience working in SaaS, cloud, digital workspace, infrastructure, or enterprise software environments.
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and relationship management skills.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with Omnissa, Workspace ONE, Horizon, Digital Employee Experience, or related End-User Computing solutions.
    • Knowledge of Customer Success methodologies, customer health frameworks, adoption strategies, and value realization practices.
    • Experience supporting renewals, retention strategies, and expansion motions.
    • Familiarity with enterprise workplace transformation and employee experience initiatives.

What is the leadership like for this role? What is the structure and culture of the team like?


The EUC Customer Success team is focused on outcomes, not activity. We help customers realize tangible business value from their Omnissa investments while building long-term strategic partnerships. We are customer-obsessed, collaborative, innovative, and committed to continuous improvement. We share best practices openly, support one another’s development, and believe that when our customers succeed, we succeed. Team members are encouraged to bring creativity, leadership, and diverse perspectives to every engagement.


Where is the role located?


This role may be remote or office-based depending on business requirements and candidate location.


Why Join Omnissa?

Join a company dedicated to transforming digital work experiences for organizations around the world. You will have the opportunity to influence customer strategy, engage with executive stakeholders, drive measurable business outcomes, and directly contribute to customer retention, growth, and advocacy. Omnissa offers opportunities for professional development, collaboration, innovation, and career growth within a customer-centric culture.

raw.description:
Overview

Join a big-five publisher and be part of our mission to inspire the world. The Zondervan Books team at HarperCollins Christian Publishing prides itself on strong author relationships, award-winning content, and a cohesive team environment and is currently seeking a Director of Marketing for our new imprint, Harper Catholic. The Zondervan Books team is proud to partner with authors such as Rick Warren, Dr. Anita Philips, Lee Strobel, Craig Groeschel, and numerous others.

The Marketing Director is a strategic, senior-level leader responsible for developing and executing integrated marketing strategies for key frontlist and select backlist titles within Zondervan Books. This role blends title marketing leadership with deep digital, content, and audience expertise to drive revenue, reader engagement, and long-term author brand growth.The Marketing Director leads high-impact campaigns across channels, grounded in a strong understanding of audience behavior, felt needs, and platform dynamics. They operate as the central strategist—aligning positioning, messaging, content, and channel execution—while partnering cross-functionally and coaching authors to connect meaningfully with their audiences in an increasingly algorithm-driven landscape.

In addition to author and title responsibilities, the Director of Marketing will assist with other initiatives to support the Zondervan Books team.

We are open to remote candidates, as well as candidates based in Nashville, TN who prefer to work from our Nashville office on a hybrid basis. Travel is required based on the need of the business.

Responsibilities

  • Lead development and execution of integrated marketing campaigns across multiple titles and seasons
  • Own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy informed by audience insight and market analysis
  • Develop deep understanding of target audiences, including motivations, behaviors, and felt needs
  • Apply platform and algorithm knowledge to shape content and channel strategy
  • Guide transformation of long-form content into high-performing digital and social assets
  • Coach authors on audience engagement, content strategy, and platform best practices
  • Partner cross-functionally with editorial, publicity, sales, and digital teams to align strategy
  • Direct development of creative assets and campaign materials
  • Manage budgets, forecasts, and campaign performance against revenue goals
  • Analyze campaign performance and optimize based on data and insights
  • Lead innovation in marketing strategy, adapting to evolving consumer and platform trends
  • Present marketing plans and results to internal stakeholders and leadership
  • Participate in acquisitions, evaluating projects for market potential and marketing approach
  • Builds and sustains strong relationships with Catholic authors, agents, clergy, scholars, and institutional partners
  • Represents Harper Catholic at conferences and industry events, serving as a visible ambassador for the imprint

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in marketing, with demonstrated leadership in campaign strategy and execution. Strong background in both traditional title marketing and digital/content marketing required.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field
  • Required: Knowledge of marketing, digital strategy, audience development, and analytics best practices. Demonstrated familiarity with the Catholic Church and its teachings. Deep understanding of Catholic readerships, institutional structures, and current publishing landscape. Conversant in consumer demand, retail environments (physical and online), and competition.
  • Preferred: Book publishing and Christian audience experience. Experience in client-service role. Existing relationships with advertising reps and media outlets who serve Catholic readers.

Skills:

  • Strategic leadership and campaign ownership
  • Deep audience insight and consumer understanding
  • Platform fluency across social and digital ecosystems
  • Content strategy and storytelling
  • Data-driven decision making and testing mindset
  • Strong communication and author-facing presence
  • Cross-functional leadership and collaboration
  • Technical proficiency with marketing tools and platforms

HarperCollins Publishers is a company full of people who are passionate about books. When you apply for a position, we want to know why you want to work here, and why you are interested in the job. That’s why cover letters are strongly preferred.

The salary range for this position is $90,000-$100,000. We recognize that attracting the best talent is key to our strategy and success as a company. As a result, we aim for flexibility in structuring competitive compensation offers to ensure we are able to attract the best candidates. The quoted salary range represents our good faith estimate as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on the selected candidate's experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process.

In addition to cash compensation, the company provides a comprehensive and highly competitive benefits package, with a variety of physical health, retirement and savings, caregiving, emotional wellbeing, transportation, and other benefits, including "elective" benefits employees may select to best fit the needs and personal situations of our diverse workforce. Visit our careers webpage for more information.

HarperCollins Christian Publishing is an equal opportunity employer.

HarperCollins Christian Publishing is committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities, in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application, due to a disability, email us at . Note: we will only respond to accommodation requests.

raw.description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

Internship details

  • Location: Remote (United States).
  • Employment Type: Part-time Internship (15-20 hours per week).
  • Duration: February 2027 - June 2027 - Candidates must remain actively enrolled in an accredited college or university throughout the internship.

How you can make a differenceThe Employee Advocacy Intern will help grow and scale HealthEquity's employee advocacy program by building teammate participation, creating engaging social content, and supporting advocates across the organization. This role provides dedicated ownership of day-to-day program operations while helping expand employee advocacy as a channel for brand awareness, thought leadership, recruitment marketing, and employer branding. This internship is ideal for a student who is passionate about social media, communications, personal branding, and storytelling. The successful candidate will help teammates confidently share their expertise, experiences, and HealthEquity's mission on social media while gaining hands-on experience in social media strategy, employee engagement, content development, and corporate communications. This role helps expand HealthEquity's ability to amplify employee voices, strengthen its employer brand, and increase awareness of the company's mission through authentic social engagement. Success in this role is defined by increased advocate participation, strong advocate engagement, compelling content creation, and the continued growth of employee advocacy as a scalable communication and marketing channel.

What you’ll be doing

  • Manage ongoing advocate communications, including onboarding, updates, reminders, and program resources.
  • Conduct monthly advocate check-ins to gather feedback and strengthen engagement.
  • Create LinkedIn posts, employee spotlight content, thought leadership prompts, campaign copy, advocacy toolkits, and educational resources that help employees develop their personal brands.
  • Support employee advocacy campaigns aligned to company initiatives, thought leadership, recruiting, and brand awareness efforts.
  • Identify and spotlight employee success stories and advocate achievements.
  • Track advocate participation, content engagement, and program performance metrics.
  • Maintain reporting dashboards and provide insights on program effectiveness.
  • Partner with Corporate Communications and Talent Acquisition stakeholders to support advocacy initiatives.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve advocate engagement, training materials, and program adoption.

What you will need to be successful

Education and Experience

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, Journalism, Digital Media, Business, or a related field.
  • Preferred candidates are entering their Junior or Senior year.
  • Must be enrolled in an accredited college or university throughout the duration of the internship.
  • Demonstrated involvement in student organizations, clubs, ambassador programs, leadership roles, or campus activities preferred.

Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Interest in social media, communications, personal branding, employer branding, or content marketing.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to build relationships and communicate effectively with teammates across all levels of the organization.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently while balancing multiple responsibilities and deadlines.
  • Curiosity about social media trends, audience engagement, and content performance.
  • Strong collaboration skills and willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism and positively represent the HealthEquity brand.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with employee advocacy platforms and/or social media management tools.
  • Basic graphic design experience using Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools.
  • Experience creating LinkedIn content and understanding professional social media best practices.
  • Experience analyzing social media performance metrics and engagement data.

What you'll gain

  • Hands-on experience managing and growing an enterprise employee advocacy program.
  • Exposure to social media strategy, employee engagement, personal branding, and employer branding initiatives.
  • Experience creating content and communications for professional audiences.
  • Opportunities to collaborate with Corporate Communications, Marketing, Talent Acquisition, and executive stakeholders.
  • Valuable experience analyzing social media and employee advocacy performance metrics.
  • Professional development in content strategy, storytelling, personal branding, communications, and marketing.
  • Real-world experience supporting a mission-driven healthcare organization.

Salary Range

At Kognitiv Inc., we’re redefining what it means to be a Workday partner. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the ecosystem, we bring deep expertise, innovative thinking, and a people-first mindset to everything we do. We’re not just building better Workday solutions—we’re building a company where talented people thrive.

Ready to do your best work? Join us.

Build the "Un-buildable" on the Workday Platform.

Our Workday Extend team is small, agile, and growing at light speed. We don’t just "configure" Workday—we treat it as a development platform. We are looking for a Consultant who wants to move beyond standard modules and dive into the world of custom objects, event-driven orchestrations, and high-impact app development. This is a rare opportunity to be a founding member of a rapidly scaling Extend practice, where you will help define our development standards and build solutions that truly didn't exist before.

The Role: Architect, Developer, Trailblazer

As an Extend Consultant, you are the bridge between a client’s "I wish Workday could do this" and a fully functional, production-ready application. You will use the Workday App Builder and Orchestration Builder to create seamless experiences that live natively within the Workday UI.

Key Technical Focus Areas:

  • App Development: Build custom apps using the Workday Extend framework, managing the full lifecycle from App Hub configuration to production deployment.

  • Orchestration: Design and build complex, event-driven Workday Orchestrations to sync data across Workday and third-party systems (using the Orchestration Builder drag-and-drop tool).

  • Data Modeling: Create and manage Custom Business Objects (CBOs) and custom processes to extend the Workday data model.

  • UI/UX Design: Craft intuitive user experiences using Page Builder, ensuring a "Workday-native" look and feel for every custom task.

  • Advanced Logic: Utilize Workday Query Language (WQL) and REST/SOAP APIs to pull, push, and transform data with precision.

What You’ll Do Day-to-Day

  • Design & Prototype: Translate complex business requirements into technical blueprints including UI flows, security domains, and data models.

  • Full-Stack Extend Delivery: Independently build, test, and deploy applications, ensuring they are "update-safe" and maintainable.

  • Troubleshoot & Optimize: Debug complex logic within orchestrations and perform root-cause analysis on app performance or security issues.

  • Practice Building: Contribute to our internal Reusable Solution Library. Since our team is small, your templates and "best practices" will become the foundation for all future hires.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Functional and Integration teams to ensure Extend apps integrate perfectly with core HCM, Finance, or Student modules.

Qualifications

  • The Foundation: 3+ years of experience in Workday Extend.

  • The Toolkit: Proficient in REST APIs, JSON, and Workday Web Services. Familiarity with WQL is a major advantage.

  • The Architect Mindset: Ability to design Workday Orchestrations and custom security models independently.

  • The Builder Spirit: Experience with App Builder (Visual and Code modes) and a solid understanding of how to extend Workday's metadata-driven architecture.

  • Growth Ready: Comfortable in a "startup-style" environment within a larger company—you are proactive, love to learn, and aren't afraid to help build the roadmap as we go.

  • Communication: Ability to explain the "Art of the Possible" with Extend to non-technical stakeholders.

The Global Risk Solutions and Strategy group is a fast-growing team optimizing risk solutions and models, and we are a key function to help enable WEX’s strategic objectives. The Risk Solutions Team employs data science methodologies (machine learning and statistical frameworks), a wide suite of data types, and modern technologies to develop solutions to inform decision making. Our team helps the firm identify and measure credit and fraud risk to proactively manage the risk throughout the client’s life-cycle. As such, you will not only be working with the latest data and machine learning technologies and algorithms, you will be working in a dynamic environment alongside our stakeholders and domain experts to build models and drive better decision-making.


About the Team/Role

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand fraud risk management requirements and translate them into data-driven solutions to measure and monitor fraud risk across the firm’s products and services.
  • Proactively identify and communicate challenges, opportunities, and risks associated with end-to-end model development and deployment life-cycle to ensure timely completion of the entire product.
  • Leverage advanced machine learning, artificial intelligence, and statistical methods and technologies to design flexible, scalable, and automated risk modeling solutions.
  • Develop and review code and automated processes to extract fraud risk patterns from large scale application and transaction data, behavioral patterns, and other risk indicators.
  • Keep abreast with emerging trends in machine learning and identify opportunities to leverage new tools to solve problems and improve processes.
  • Mentor and support junior data scientists, sharing knowledge and best practices to elevate the data science practice at WEX.

How you'll make an impact

About Ascent

Ascent Global Logistics, headquartered in Belleville, Michigan, is a leading global provider of expedited, time-critical logistics solutions and other direct transportation services. The company connects customers to its extensive carrier network, internal ground fleet and airline via its proprietary, digital PEAK freight marketplace, which provides robust carrier capacity and transparent pricing, backed by 24/7/365 logistics experts. Ascent’s offerings include air charter and ground expedited solutions as well as truckload, less-than-truckload, global forwarding, brokerage, and managed transportation services. The experienced Ascent team solves customers’ most challenging logistics needs by providing industry-leading service and top-tier satisfaction.


Our Guiding Principles

At the core of Ascent's culture is a strong commitment to excellence, driven by the passion and dedication of every team member. We're equally dedicated to going above and beyond for our customers, ensuring this commitment extends beyond our team and brings exceptional value to those we serve. We aim for perfect execution in everything we do and ‘play hard’ by creating an environment where tasks are performed with a can-do attitude from start to finish. We ‘play smart’ by delivering on our commitments in an honest, fair and ethical manner. We treat every person with whom we interface with the utmost dignity and respect. We understand that our teammates are our most valuable assets, so we ‘play together’ by making every effort to provide a professional and enjoyable experience, enabling careers to flourish and personal growth to be achieved.


What You’ll Do

The Operational Key Account Manager (OKAM) is the performance owner of a portfolio of Ascent’s most important key account customers. The role is accountable for end-to-end service performance — SLAs, KPIs, continuous improvement, and cost-to-serve — across the assigned accounts. The OKAM runs the day-to-day operational cadence, owns issue resolution, and ensures Ascent delivers consistent, measurable execution on the commercial commitments made by the Growth KAM. Working closely with Operations, Control Tower, IT, and Finance, the OKAM turns performance data into customer-facing insight and continuous improvement — a hands-on, execution-focused role for a disciplined operational leader.


  • Own Day-to-Day Service Performance — Accountable for SLA/KPI delivery (OTIF, TTFB, claims, win/capture) across the assigned account portfolio; run the weekly and monthly operational cadence with the customer.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement & Savings — Lead the CI roadmap for each account — identify systemic issues, deliver measurable cost-to-serve and OTIF improvements, and convert performance trends into documented savings.
  • Lead Root-Cause Analysis & CAPA — Own issue resolution, root-cause investigation, and corrective/preventive action for escalations; close the loop with Operations and the customer on sustainable fixes.
  • Maintain SOPs & Operational Governance — Design, maintain, and govern the account SOPs; ensure cross-regional consistency and smooth onboarding of new lanes, modes, or scopes awarded by the Growth KAM.
  • Deliver Performance Visibility via Power BI — Own the customer’s KPI dashboards and scorecards; turn Power BI data into structured performance narratives for internal reviews and customer QBRs.
  • Coordinate Cross-Functional Execution — Act as the central bridge between the customer’s operational teams, Ascent Operations, Control Tower, IT, and Finance; ensure one coordinated service delivery for the customer.

What You’ll Bring

Work Experience

  • 6+ years of progressive operational experience in logistics, supply chain, or freight forwarding — with a proven track record of managing complex, multi-modal customer accounts.
  • Demonstrated success owning SLA/KPI performance (OTIF, claims, cost-to-serve) across global, multi-region customer footprints.
  • Hands-on experience leading continuous improvement initiatives that delivered measurable savings and service-level uplift.
  • Proven ability to run root-cause analysis (5 Whys, fishbone, CAPA) and drive systemic corrective actions with Operations.
  • Experience authoring and governing SOPs, account playbooks, and onboarding documentation for complex customer flows.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Strong operational mindset — disciplined, detail-oriented, and relentless about execution against the SLA.
  • Analytical and data-driven — expert-level Power BI and Excel for KPI reporting, trend analysis, and customer scorecards.
  • Excellent communication skills — confident presenting service performance to senior customer stakeholders in QBRs and issue reviews.
  • Proven cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Control Tower, IT, and Finance without direct authority.
  • Knowledge of CargoWise or equivalent TMS, PEAK Marketplace integrations, and shipment-level data flows a strong plus.
  • Bilingual (English / Spanish) a plus, given cross-border US-MX account scope.

Educational Background

  • Bachelor’s degree required — preferably in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • Advanced degree (MBA, MS in Supply Chain / Operations) a plus.
  • Relevant professional certifications strongly preferred — APICS / CSCP, Lean Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt), PMP, or equivalent.

Why This Role Matters:

The OKAM is the execution engine of Ascent’s 2026 Key Account Operating Model. By owning day-to-day service performance, the OKAM frees the Growth KAM to focus on commercial strategy, protects customer trust through disciplined delivery, and turns operational data into value and measurable savings — the foundation of Ascent’s customer experience.savings — the foundatin of Ascent’s customer experienc

This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Your role at Baxter


As the Senior Manager, Customer Success, you will lead the strategy, transformation, and ongoing development of Baxter's Customer Success organization within Customer Experience & Delivery. You will be responsible for driving product adoption, customer outcomes, retention, and value realization across Baxter's growing connected care portfolio. This is an opportunity to shape the future of a critical function that sits at the intersection of customer experience, technology, healthcare operations, and commercial strategy.


We are looking for a leader who enjoys building and scaling organizations. While Baxter has a talented and passionate team in place, the Customer Success function is still evolving. Today, the team supports customer adoption, engagement, renewals, and escalations, but the goal is to create a more proactive, standardized, and metrics-driven customer success organization. The ideal candidate has experience building or transforming Customer Success teams and can introduce best practices, playbooks, customer health frameworks, KPIs, governance models, and operational rigor that enable long-term scalability and measurable results.


You will lead a team of Customer Success Leaders and Connected System Application Engineers with backgrounds spanning clinical operations, analytics, project management, and customer-facing support. Success in this role will require a balance of strategic leadership, operational excellence, change management, and customer engagement. You will establish clear expectations, define measures of success, leverage tools such as Gainsight, and create repeatable processes that enable the team to deliver a world-class customer experience. Working closely with Sales, Enterprise Accounts, Clinical Operations, Product Management, Engineering, Technical Support, and implementation teams, you will help ensure customers experience one coordinated Baxter while influencing stakeholders, challenging the status quo, and driving meaningful customer outcomes.


This is a remote position based in the United States and requires approximately 30% travel to customer sites and Baxter locations throughout the U.S.


What you'll be doing


  • Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of Customer Success Leaders and Connected System Application Engineers while building a high-performing, customer-focused organization.

About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we’re growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

Position Summary

As a Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) at Blackbird Health, you’ll play an essential role in delivering high-quality, comprehensive psychiatric evaluations, treatment planning, and medication management for children, adolescents, and young adults. You’ll build meaningful relationships with patients and families, taking the time to understand their needs, support engagement in treatment, and educate them on care options that foster long-term progress.

Working alongside an interdisciplinary team of psychotherapists, specialists, and clinical leaders, you’ll be empowered to make a tangible difference in the lives of young patients and their families through compassionate, evidence-based care.

We’re seeking dedicated prescribers to join our team and serve children, adolescents, and young adults ages 2–26. Multiple remote employment tracks are available: you’ll select your preferred arrangement in the application.

Employment Options

W2 Full-Time (FTE) | PMHNP

  • Compensation:
    • Base Salary: $145,000 – $155,000 base salary.
  • Hours & Schedule:
    • Workload: Fully remote position with a commitment supporting completed clinical direct care hours.
    • Commitment: 34 clinical direct-care hours per week.
    • Core Hours: Minimum commitment during peak "after school" core windows (after 4:00 PM ET weekdays and/or weekends).
  • Full Benefits Package: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, employer-paid life insurance, generous paid time off + 11 paid holidays, and professional liability insurance coverage.

W2 Part-Time (20 hrs/week) | PMHNP

  • Compensation:
    • Base Salary: $72,500 base salary for part-time schedule.
    • Incentive Pay: Earn $100 per completed clinical hour for additional sessions beyond your base caseload.
  • Hours & Onsite Expectations:
    • Commitment: 20 contracted hours per week (17 clinical direct-care hours).
    • Core Schedule: Minimum 10 hours anchored in peak core windows (after 3:00 PM ET weekdays and/or weekends).
  • Benefits: Full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, generous PTO + 11 paid holidays, paid weekly clinical consultation, and covered liability insurance.

1099 Contractor | PMHNP

  • Compensation (Flat-Rate NJ):
    • Hourly Pay: $120.00 flat rate per completed clinical hour.
  • Hours & Flexibility:
    • Minimum Commitment: 15 open patient-care hours/week to support a target baseline of 12 completed clinical hours/week.
    • Core Requirement: Hours anchored during peak core windows (after 3:00 PM ET weekdays and/or weekends).
  • Perks: Full credentialing support, paid weekly clinical consultation, liability insurance covered, and reimbursement for client no-shows.

Why Blackbird & Your Impact

  • Focus on Patient Care: Full administrative support—we handle credentialing, billing, insurance, and EHR administration so you can focus entirely on your clinical work.
  • Guaranteed Patient Referrals: Start seeing patients right away with a predictable caseload.
  • Grow as a Clinician: Paid weekly clinical consultation and peer support are built into your schedule for ongoing skill development.
  • Integrated Care Model: Work closely alongside psychotherapists, speech therapists, OTs, and neuropsychology specialists to treat the whole child.
  • Mission-Driven Culture: Join a collaborative, intelligent, and compassionate network of professionals shaping the future of pediatric behavioral health.

Who You Are

  • Licensure: Active New Jersey PMHNP/CRNP/APN license, active DEA registration, and State Prescriptive Authority.
  • Certification: Board Certified by ANCC or AANP (PMHNP-BC).
  • Education: Master’s Degree from an accredited nursing program.
  • Experience: 1+ years of independent psychiatric experience working under licensure (with direct experience serving children, adolescents, or young adults).
  • Availability: Available during Blackbird's peak core hours (after 3:00 PM ET weekdays and/or weekends).
  • Technical Skills: Tech-savvy and equipped with a computer, phone, high-speed internet, and proficiency in EHR systems and Google Suite.

To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child’s brain, body, and behavior work together.

Position:

Network / Technical Support Engineer (English & Spanish speaker)

Job Description:

Our Story


We are an American Fortune 500 company headquartered in Centennial, Colorado. The company specializes in distribution and value-added services relating to electronic components and computer products.


At Arrow ECS we are at the forefront of new internet security technology, providing businesses with technical expertise. As a company we sell, install and maintain customer’s software and hardware solutions such as firewalls, antivirus, web filtering, virtual infrastructures, network traffic load balancers to name a few. Our customers can range from small businesses through to some of the biggest companies in the world. We work with these customers to ensure that their IT infrastructure is, fast, reliable, secure and most importantly working well for their needs.


Our main goal is to provide technical support to our Global customers and partners. Our portfolio is varied and includes best of breed vendors such as CheckPoint, NetApp, Fortinet, Palo Alto, F5, Microsoft and more so there is lots to learn!


What You Will Be Doing at Arrow?


Your job will be to provide technical support via email/telephone/remote sessions to our global customers, using initiative to help customers as much as possible.


You will deliver our range of technical support services and investigate any issues that arise.


Where necessary you will need to replicate customer configurations as required to troubleshoot complex errors, in details:

  • Provide 2nd & 3rd line technical support via email/telephone/live-chat to our global customers, using initiative to help customers as much as possible. A percentage of calls will be of a complex technical nature.
  • Resolve escalated support incidents from our customers and partners.
  • Replicate customer configurations as required to troubleshoot complex errors.
  • Progress simultaneous high-profile/high-priority issues.
  • Undertake to develop and maintain technical skills in selected products.
  • Undertake training to achieve and maintain accreditation in selected products.

Who Are We Looking For?


The ideal candidate would be someone who is passionate about networking, security, Linux and all things technical. On that role you will have the opportunity to acquire lots of new skills, so it's important that you are keen to learn and embrace new technologies and commit to rapid skills development.


Therefore, what is essential for us:

  • Understanding of TCP/IP, routing, switching and related protocols, network environments and topologies.
  • Display a thorough understanding of networking protocols.
  • Understanding and experience of TCP/IP, routing, switching and related protocols.
  • Administration, installation and troubleshooting of Windows or Linux based devices and networks.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both telephone and written.
  • Excellent English language skills both written and verbal, proficiency in Spanish. French and German language as an asset.

What is in it For You?


We have trained our engineering team to be able to cope with interesting, complex and diverse technical issues from small companies though to large enterprise corporations.


We believe in supporting new engineers in their training with industry recognized qualifications, as they prepare to work directly with our customers and develop their practical skills and experience in a range of technologies. Engineers are developed in all aspects of the role from customer services skills and specific vendor certifications. We will tailor your development and we will ensure that we hone your technical, customer service and professional skills.


Arrow is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

This is a position in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. The Lead Accountant will report to the Senior Manager, Accounting Operations. The successful candidate will manage and be accountable for the day-to-day accounting operations of Resilience, including month-end accounting close and reconciliations. This role leads and develops a team of accountants and serves as a trusted business partner to finance leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. The individual will work closely with various parties including other accounting/finance team members as well as partners outside of the broader finance team, including Payroll, HR, etc.


Job Responsibilities

  • Lead the monthly close process, including review of journal entries, balance sheet and P&L account reconciliations, and analytical reviews, and ensure close deadlines are met.
  • Ensure compliance with GAAP and company accounting policies; own the design and operation of internal controls over payroll and general accounting processes in support of Sarbanes-Oxley requirements; and serve as a key contact for internal and external auditors.
