  • Oversee maintenance of ADP GLI and its related controls.
  • Partner with the external reporting team to ensure key inputs are complete, accurate and delivered on time.
  • Drive the design, improvement and implementation of systems and processes to facilitate timely and accurate closing of monthly financial statements, leveraging technology to increase effectiveness.
  • Oversee non-payroll or benefit related GL account reconciliations and ensure they are completed accurately and on time.
  • Partner with Payroll, HR and other cross-functional stakeholders to resolve issues, align processes, and ensure accurate and timely inputs to the close.
  • Resolve complex accounting issues independently, escalating to the Senior Manager only those matters with significant financial, control or policy implications.
  • Lead ad hoc projects, as requested.

  • Significant and progressive accounting experience, with a mix of public accounting and manufacturing industry experience, including multiple years in a supervisory or team-lead capacity.

  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills, specifically Excel.
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, ADP, and/or Workday.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, including the ability to influence and communicate effectively with senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines without sacrificing quality.
  • Must demonstrate initiative, ownership and sound judgment, and be able to work independently as well as part of a team.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment.
  • Adaptability and flexibility in leading through changing priorities and business needs.
  • Possess a mind-set to leverage technology and automation to increase efficiency.
  • Ability to develop workstream/project plan, communicate plan effectively to relevant parties and drive adherence to due dates.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment in resolving complex issues.

Preferred Quallifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or related field.
  • 6+ years of accounting experience, with a mix of public accounting and industry experience, including at least 2 years in a supervisory or team-lead capacity.
  • Experience leading accounting process improvement or system implementation initiatives.
  • CPA and experience in a public accounting firm preferred.
  • SAP and Blackline experience preferred.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Project Control Analyst to support budgeting, cost tracking, financial forecasting, and PMO reporting for a large federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. These roles track program burn rates, monitor spending against CLIN structures, analyze variances, and generate recurring financial metrics for leadership.

The Project Control Analysts work closely with program managers, schedulers, finance personnel, and technical leads to ensure accurate, timely program financial governance aligned with federal acquisition and PMO standards.

These positions are fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Track program financials including burn rates, actuals, and cost-to-complete forecasting.
  • Monitor and update CLIN-level financials, forecasts, and expenditure profiles.
  • Develop recurring financial metrics, dashboards, and monthly PMO reporting packages.
  • Support variance analysis and identify cost risks, overruns, or underruns.
  • Coordinate with scheduling teams to align cost and schedule data for accurate forecasting.
  • Maintain financial documentation, audit support records, and contract-required reporting.
  • Assist with obligation tracking, invoicing validation, and subcontractor financial coordination.
  • Support budget development, annual planning cycles, and financial scenario modeling.
  • Participate in PMO reviews, governance sessions, and milestone readiness meetings.
  • Ensure financial tracking aligns with federal, DoD, and acquisition compliance standards.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

Candidate must possess an active Secret clearance or higher.

Education (Required)

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in project control, financial analysis, or program financial management.
  • Experience supporting financial tracking for federal, DoD, or government contracting programs.
  • Experience preparing monthly financial metrics, burn-rate analysis, and forecast updates.
  • Experience supporting PMO financial governance, audits, or contract reporting activities.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

  • Proficiency with Excel, financial modeling, and budget tracking tools.
  • Understanding of CLIN structures, contract types (FFP, T&M, CPFF), and cost tracking methodologies.
  • Familiarity with PMO frameworks and cost-schedule integration best practices.

Technical Knowledge (Preferred)

  • Experience with cost accounting systems or ERP tools used in federal contracting.
  • Knowledge of EVM principles or PMBOK financial management practices.

Certifications

Preferred:

  • Certified Defense Financial Manager (CDFM)
  • PMP or Agile certifications

Skills

  • Strong analytical and numerical reasoning skills.
  • Excellent communication and documentation abilities.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a mission-driven PMO environment.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration across finance and technical teams.

This trusted M&A TR advisor partners closely with Corporate Development, Finance, Legal, People Business Partners (PBPs), and People & Places leadership to assess workforce impacts, identify people related risks, and support informed, market aligned rewards decisions. You translate fast-moving and ambiguous deal inputs into clear, pragmatic recommendations that balance internal equity, external market competitiveness, cost, and employee experience.

Responsibilities

Deal Lifecycle Support

· Support end-to-end Total Rewards activities across M&A transactions, including due diligence, integration planning, deal modeling, close execution, and post-close integration

· Evaluate target company compensation structures, incentive plans, equity programs, and benefits positioning to identify risks, gaps, and integration considerations

· Partner with Finance and Corporate Development to support cost modeling, synergy assumptions, and people related deal risks

· Support communications and enablement related to compensation, benefits, retention programs, and other Total Rewards changes throughout the transaction lifecycle

Total Rewards & Market Analysis

· Conduct job and level mapping using Autodesk job architecture and market data

· Analyze internal and external market positioning to inform pay alignment, equity conversion, and retention recommendations

· Develop compensation, equity, and retention recommendations for executives and key talent populations where retention or leadership continuity is critical

· Assess target company benefits, identify gaps vs. company programs, and execute compliant, cost-effective transition and harmonization plans

· Support the design of transition, retention, and harmonization approaches consistent with Autodesk Total Rewards principles

Advisory & Stakeholder Partnership

· Partner with PBPs, Legal, and business leaders to surface implications, tradeoffs, and recommended paths forward

· Prepare clear, decision-ready materials that summarize options, risks, and financial impact for leadership review

· Apply established governance and approval frameworks consistently across transactions

Execution & Integration

· Support or lead execution of approved Total Rewards actions in Workday and downstream systems

· Support cross-functional planning and coordination to ensure Total Rewards deliverables, dependencies, and milestones remain on track throughout the transaction lifecycle

· Coordinate closely with HR Operations, Payroll, and related teams to ensure accurate and timely implementation

· Contribute to continuous improvement of M&A Total Rewards playbooks, tools, and templates based on deal learnings

· Provide project management support for Total Rewards activities across the M&A lifecycle, ensuring seamless execution and issue resolution

Broader Compensation Support

During periods of low M&A activity, this role is expected to flex across other Compensation functions, including:

  • Support Executive Compensation activities, including equity modeling and forecasting, peer group proxy data analysis, and preparation of Compensation Committee materials
  • Contribute to broad-based compensation activities, including benchmarking and retention analysis, and support annual compensation planning cycles

Minimum Qualifications 

  • Experience in Total Rewards, Compensation, and/or M&A related HR work
  • 5+ years of experience supporting M&A transactions, integration, compensation, or workforce-related initiatives
  • Strong analytical capability, including compensation modeling and market data interpretation
  • Working knowledge of job architecture, leveling, and market pricing principles
  • Demonstrated ability to operate with discretion and handle highly confidential information
  • Comfort working in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments with shifting priorities and tight timelines
  • Strong cross-functional communication / presentation skills with business leaders

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Exposure to global compensation practices or multi-country integrations
  • Expertise in total rewards programs including employee benefits, with demonstrated experience in M&A integration, gap analysis, and program harmonization
  • Experience partnering with Corporate Development, Finance, or Legal teams

The Senior Business Systems Analyst performs analysis of business, process and user needs, documentation of requirements, cost/benefit analysis and translation into proper system requirement specifications. This position works on assignments involving moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

The Senior Business Systems Analyst formulates and defines systems and objectives based on both user needs and a good understanding of applicable business systems and industry requirements. Devises or modifies procedures and processes to solve complex problems considering computing capacity and limitations, operating time, and form of desired results. Validates benefits achieved from solution implementation. Begins to influence department's strategy. Make decisions on moderately complex to complex issues regarding technical approach for project components, and work is performed without direction. Exercises considerable latitude in determining objectives and approaches to assignments.

The Senior Business Systems Analyst will support business-critical initiatives across OneHome’s business operations, including platform modernization, operational enhancements, production support, and regulatory changes. Serving as a key liaison between business and technology teams, this role will translate business needs into clear requirements and help deliver effective, scalable solutions that achieve business objectives.

This role will build deep knowledge of OneHome’s business processes, technology platforms, data flows, and integrations while partnering with Operations and Technology teams to drive transformation and continuous improvement. Key responsibilities include requirements analysis and management, process optimization, testing coordination, production support, process documentation, reporting, and successful implementation of system enhancements.


Use your skills to make an impact

Additional Job Description

  • 5 or more years of technical experience. Hands-on experience in a technology environment, either as part of a technology team or supporting technology initiatives, with working knowledge of Microsoft technologies.
  • Working knowledge of ad-hoc query tools and data repositories that support data extraction and manipulation
  • Knowledge of Systems Development Life Cycle
  • Experience in problem analysis and process
  • Comprehensive knowledge of all Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, and Visio
  • Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences
  • Experience in one or more of the following - Care Coordination, Care Management, Post Acute Care, Healthcare Claims Management, Revenue Cycle Management

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration, Finance, or any related field.
  • Agile/Scrum certifications
  • Six Sigma certification
  • PMP certification
  • Demonstrated experience with process documentation and re-engineering
  • 2yrs. Healthcare Background

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

40

raw.description:
About Wonder

Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise.

Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. With Wonder, you can mix and match hundreds of dishes from 20+ exclusive restaurants in a single order, so everyone gets exactly what they’re craving. Enjoy everything from tacos to Thai with $0 delivery fees, plus dine-in or pick up at a Wonder location near you. Each dish is made to order on-site by our culinary team and served hot.

Behind the scenes, Wonder owns and operates every step of the dining experience, from recipe development to the technology that powers our experience, allowing us to deliver quality, variety, and consistency at scale.

Join us as we work to make great food more accessible.

**PLEASE NOTE: This role provides oversight for our Mid-Atlantic region. Residency within the supported region (DE, MD, DC or VA) is a requirement, as the position involves extensive regional travel.**

About The Opportunity
We are seeking a Market People Leader ("aka" Regional HR Business Partner), to work strategically with our Regional Vice Presidents, Market Operations Directors, and multi-unit field leadership teams across a multi-state footprint. As a senior individual contributor, you will translate the field’s people strategy into actionable, data-informed programs and initiatives—designing and deploying solutions that elevate leadership capability, address root causes, and scale effectively across regions.

The Market People Leader will operate across a large and complex hourly and salaried workforce environment. They will be deeply embedded with field leadership—supporting strategic planning, diagnosing organizational opportunities, creating scalable interventions, and executing project-based and tactical people initiatives. The ideal candidate brings significant multi-unit HRBP experience within QSR, food & beverage, hospitality, or retail and excels at balancing strategic influence with hands-on execution.

The Impact You Will Make

Strategic Leadership & Business Partnership

  • Serve as the primary strategic HR partner to Regional Vice Presidents and Market Operations Directors across multiple markets.

  • Recommend, translate, and execute people initiatives aligned with operational goals, including workforce planning, leadership capability, retention, and culture.

  • Anticipate emerging needs and challenges, proactively offering solutions—not just surfacing issues.

  • Use data, trends, and insights to inform decisions and create interventions that scale across regions and store formats.

  • Lead with a high level of independence, navigating ambiguity while influencing leadership toward optimal people decisions.

  • Influence leaders toward effective, long-term people decisions through strong judgment, business acumen, and operational understanding.

Strategic + Tactical Execution & Field Enablement

  • Operate with end-to-end ownership, shifting fluidly between strategic planning, project execution, and tactical tasks that support daily operations.

  • Drive and support enterprise initiatives (performance cycles, compensation reviews, org design changes, HR system launches) while ensuring field execution and adoption.

  • Build repeatable, scalable processes that reduce manual lift for stores and improve consistency across regions.

  • Establish rhythms, standards, and operating mechanisms that ensure consistency of HR support across regions.

Organizational Effectiveness & Workforce Strategy

  • Diagnose root causes of operational and people challenges such as turnover, staffing models, leadership gaps, and team effectiveness, and develop targeted, scalable solutions to address them.

  • Partner with field leaders to design and execute workforce plans that support current and future business needs, including staffing strategies, labor optimization, performance management, and leadership bench development.

  • Implement interventions that improve operational readiness, strengthen leadership performance, and reinforce long-term organizational health across markets.

  • Use analytical and dashboards to generate insights and make data-backed recommendations that enhance workflows, shift behaviors, and influence long-term strategy.

Employee Relations & Culture Stewardship

  • Serve as the escalation point for complex employee relations matters across multiple districts.

  • Guide leaders in consistent application of policies, values, and leadership behaviors.

  • Shape and reinforce programs that enhance engagement, build teamwork, and reduce avoidable employee friction.

Talent Development & Leadership Capability

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition on hiring strategies, forecasting, and capability planning for leaders and hourly teams.

  • Support and influence leadership development, succession planning, career pathing, and bench readiness for multi-unit operations.

  • Coach leaders to elevate their decision-making, communication, and team leadership effectiveness.

HR Operations, Compliance, & Risk Management

  • Ensure all practices comply with federal, state, and local requirements across a growing multi-state footprint.

  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure strong execution of core HR programs including benefits, compensation, accommodations, investigations, and performance cycles.

  • Apply strong risk judgment to protect the business while maintaining trust and fairness across teams.

Change Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead people-related components of change tied to new market expansion, org design shifts, process improvements, or structural realignments.

  • Diagnose operational inefficiencies and create scalable HR processes that support growth and reduce complexity for leaders.

  • Influence field adoption of new tools, systems, and workflows through clear communication and partnership.

​

What You Bring to the Table

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.

  • 8+ years of progressive HRBP experience, with significant time supporting multi-unit operations in QSR, food & beverage, hospitality, or retail.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate people strategy into scalable, effective initiatives that drive meaningful business outcomes.

  • Proven experience operating as a senior-level individual contributor with strong cross-functional influence.

  • Exceptional ability to anticipate needs, diagnose problems, and drive solutions that scale.

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret trends and turn insights into action.

  • Knowledge of employment laws and compliance considerations across multiple states.

  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and influencing skills with leaders at all levels.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with competing priorities and continuously evolving structures, processes, and practices.

As a matter of company policy, Wonder does not sponsor applicants for employment visa status for this role.

United States: $115,00 - $143,00 per year.

Wonder uses geographic-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience.

Benefits


The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands.


Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here.

At Wonder, we build the best teams by hiring with an objective lens — evaluating people for their potential while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, marital status, disability, or any other protected class. As part of our commitment to fair and compliant hiring practices, Wonder participates in the federal government's E-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility. If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

We look forward to hearing from you! We'll contact you via email or text to schedule interviews and share information about your candidacy.

Are you a Salesforce Administrator who enjoys keeping the platform clean, secure, optimized, and easy for teams to use? Do you thrive in a fast-moving B2B environment where you can improve processes, support users, and help teams get more value from Salesforce?

About the role
The Salesforce Certified Administrator role is focused on ensuring the health, security, governance, and adoption of a Salesforce platform that supports Sales, Marketing, and business operations.
This role supports Salesforce administration, automation, data integrity, reporting, system updates, integrations, and user enablement across cross-functional teams.
As Salesforce Certified Administrator, you will partner with stakeholders to streamline business processes, optimize workflows, strengthen platform governance, and support ongoing adoption through training, documentation, and responsive user support.

We're anticipating future openings and are connecting now with great talent who'd like to be considered when the time comes.

What You'll Work On
As Salesforce Certified Administrator, you will:
• Ensure the health, security, and governance of the Salesforce instance through best practices and compliance standards.
• Manage Salesforce administration, including user access, security settings, workflows, Process Builder, and Flows.
• Maintain data integrity, de-duplication, and data security policies.
• Support Salesforce audits, system updates, release management, and upgrades.
• Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and analytics for Sales, Marketing, and business teams.
• Implement standard data management practices to improve data accuracy and usability.
• Analyze Salesforce data to provide insights that inform business decisions and optimize processes.
• Partner with Sales, Marketing, and cross-functional stakeholders to enhance workflows and operational efficiency.
• Design and implement business processes that streamline operations across supported teams.
• Drive Salesforce adoption through training, documentation, and ongoing user support.
• Manage integrations between Salesforce and third-party technologies.
• Respond to helpdesk requests and troubleshoot configuration and performance issues across Salesforce and integrated systems.

What You'll Bring
You will likely be successful in this role if you have:
• Minimum 5+ years of Salesforce administration experience, preferably in a B2B environment.
• Valid, active Salesforce Certified Administrator certification required; additional Salesforce certifications are highly preferred.
• Experience within a consulting, systems integration, or implementation services environment is highly preferred.
• Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce automation tools, including Flows, Process Builder, and Workflow Rules.
• Experience with data analysis and reporting tools such as Analytics Studio or Tableau preferred but not required.
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing demands.
• Creative, analytical problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
• Proven relationship-building and collaboration skills across cross-functional stakeholders.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, responding to challenges with professionalism and composure.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including user training and support.

How You Work
• You bring a practical, ownership-minded approach to Salesforce administration, balancing platform governance, user needs, and business priorities.
• You are organized and responsive, able to manage requests, system updates, stakeholder needs, and process improvements without losing sight of quality or detail.
• You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical users, helping teams understand how to use Salesforce effectively and consistently.

Bonus Points If You Have
• Additional Salesforce certifications beyond Salesforce Certified Administrator.
• Experience supporting Salesforce in a consulting, systems integration, or implementation services environment.
• Experience with Analytics Studio, Tableau, or other reporting and analytics tools.
• Experience managing Salesforce integrations with third-party technologies.
• Experience supporting Salesforce adoption, training programs, documentation, or enablement for business users.

What Success Looks Like
• Salesforce users have the access, support, training, and documentation needed to work effectively.
• Salesforce data is cleaner, more accurate, more secure, and easier for business teams to use.
• Reports, dashboards, and analytics provide clear insight for Sales, Marketing, and leadership teams.
• Workflows, automation, and business processes are streamlined to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
• Stakeholders view you as a trusted Salesforce partner who brings responsiveness, platform discipline, and thoughtful problem-solving.

Why Join FormativGroup
FormativGroup is a PE-backed technology consulting and implementation partner helping organizations modernize complex business platforms, improve delivery outcomes, and scale technology solutions that support long-term growth. We partner with clients across strategy, solution design, implementation, and ongoing support to help move critical initiatives from vision to execution. At FormativGroup, you'll work with people who are practical, collaborative, and focused on solving meaningful business and technology problems. We're growing, which means you'll have opportunities to contribute ideas, work closely with experienced leaders, and help shape how we deliver for clients.

raw.title: Data Product Owner
raw.excerpt: Marathon Health is a leading advanced primary care provider, partnering with employer and union plan sponsors to improve health for millions of Americans.
raw.description:
Marathon Health is a leading advanced primary care provider, partnering with employer and union plan sponsors to improve health for millions of Americans. With nationwide onsite, nearsite, and network health centers, and virtual primary care, Marathon delivers a value-based model that enhances the healthcare experience for members and providers, while driving meaningful cost savings for plan sponsors. Marathon is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work®, reflecting the company's commitment to building an inclusive, high-trust culture where all employees can thrive. Learn more at

ABOUT THE JOB

The Data Product Owner leads several cross-functional scrum teams responsible for delivering outcome-based data solutions to the business. This role is defined by the problems it solves, not the technology it uses. Whether the right answer is a Tableau dashboard, a Snowflake Cortex agent, a Python-based insight package delivered as a Streamlit portal, or a reusable component of our semantic model, the Data Product Owner is accountable for choosing the approach that best achieves the desired outcome and for guiding their teams to build it.


Our stakeholders are primarily internal, though some solutions serve external audiences, and their needs evolve quickly. This person must be comfortable operating in an environment where both Technology and Product direction change, treating that change as a normal condition rather than a disruption. A major part of the mandate is enablement: building the foundational pieces — starting with a well-structured semantic model — that let stakeholders and teams across the organization build their own solutions, inside and outside of Technology. The ideal candidate is fluent in leveraging AI to accelerate how these solutions get designed, built, and maintained.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the product vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for a portfolio of outcome-based data solutions serving internal and external stakeholders.
  • Lead multiple scrum teams day to day — including backlog grooming, sprint planning, prioritization, and removing blockers — while keeping teams focused on measurable outcomes over outputs.
  • Take direction from the Director of Business Intelligence on analytics and reporting outcomes, and from the Technical Product Manager on technical and product execution, reconciling their input into a single prioritized backlog.
  • Proactively surface conflicts in priority or direction early, and drive them to resolution rather than letting teams stall.
  • Translate stakeholder goals into clearly defined problems, success metrics, and acceptance criteria, and validate that delivered solutions actually move those metrics.
  • Select the right delivery approach for each problem (e.g., Tableau, Snowflake / Cortex agents, Python / Streamlit portals) based on the outcome and the audience, rather than defaulting to a preferred technology or pattern.
  • Leverage AI and modern tooling to accelerate discovery, prototyping, development, and iteration across the teams.
  • Build and steward foundational, reusable components — especially the semantic model — so that stakeholders and other teams can reliably build their own solutions against a trusted, governed layer.
  • Establish and support self-service enablement, including documentation, patterns, and guardrails, so users can create their own solutions with confidence.
  • Partner closely with Product leaders and internal stakeholders who depend on these solutions, keeping all parties aligned on priorities, tradeoffs, and delivery status.
  • Anticipate and absorb change from both Technology and Product, adjusting priorities and communicating impacts without losing delivery momentum.
  • Ensure solutions meet quality, security, and compliance expectations appropriate to internal and external use.
  • Track adoption, usage, and business impact, and use those insights to continuously refine the portfolio.
  • Define success metrics and business outcomes for all major initiatives and hold teams accountable for measuring realized value after delivery.
  • Ensure solutions follow established release, change management, and production readiness processes.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus a minimum of 7 years proven experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar role delivering data, analytics, or BI products, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Demonstrated success leading Agile / Scrum teams, ideally more than one team concurrently. Strong background in data and analytics, with the ability to reason about data products end to end (source to consumption). Experience in healthcare, population health, benefits administration, or related regulated industries preferred. Experience working with data governance, data quality, and master data initiatives preferred.


DESIRED ATTRIBUTES

  • Hands-on familiarity with Snowflake, including Cortex agents, Cortex Analyst / search services, and semantic views.
  • Experience with modern analytics and delivery tools such as Tableau, Python, and Streamlit (or comparable frameworks for building lightweight portals and insight packages).
  • Practical fluency in leveraging AI / LLMs to build, accelerate, or augment data solutions.
  • Strong grasp of semantic modeling and the value of a reusable, governed foundation that enables self-service.
  • An outcome-first, technology-agnostic mindset: chooses the right tool for the job and lets go of tools that no longer fit.
  • Highly adaptable and calm amid shifting Technology and Product priorities.
  • Diplomatic and decisive: builds trust with multiple stakeholders and makes clear prioritization calls when direction conflicts.
  • A builder-and-enabler orientation: as motivated by helping others create solutions as by delivering their own.
  • Curiosity and a habit of continuous learning as the tooling landscape evolves.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, comfortable working with both Product leadership and non-technical business users.
  • Experience managing product backlogs in Azure DevOps or similar tools.
  • Awareness of data governance, security, and privacy considerations (experience handling sensitive or regulated data such as PHI is a plus).
  • Comfort selecting and working across a range of delivery technologies rather than specializing in a single one.
  • Experience operating in an environment of frequent change and ambiguity.
  • Track record of translating business needs into prioritized, outcome-driven work and measuring results.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a matrixed structure, taking direction from multiple leaders while managing competing priorities.

Pay Range: $110,000 - $140,000/yr

The actual offer may vary dependent upon geographic location and the candidate’s years of experience and/or skill level.


We are accepting applications for this position until a candidate has been selected. To apply to this position and learn more about open jobs at Marathon Health, visit our careers page.

The Bankruptcy Specialist is responsible for the day-to-day administration of bankruptcy accounts, including processing bankruptcy filings, maintaining account records, monitoring case activity, and ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements. Works with customers, attorneys, trustees, vendors, and internal business partners to support accurate and timely servicing of bankruptcy accounts.


Job Duties:

  • Review, analyze, and process bankruptcy filings, notifications, correspondence, and other account activity to determine account status and ensure appropriate handling in accordance with established service levels, quality standards, and legal requirements.
  • Perform bankruptcy account maintenance activities, including account reconciliation, correction of discrepancies, and processing of servicing actions to ensure accurate account administration throughout the bankruptcy lifecycle.
  • Monitor bankruptcy accounts and complete required documentation, recordkeeping, loan modifications, payment deferrals, and other account adjustments in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Communicate with customers, attorneys, trustees, vendors, and other stakeholders to obtain information, resolve bankruptcy related issues, explain the impact of bankruptcy proceedings, and address account inquiries.
  • Partner with Legal, Collections, Servicing, and other internal business partners to ensure bankruptcy accounts are managed appropriately, including matters related to defaults, repossessions, charge-offs, and regulatory compliance.
  • Ensure compliance with bankruptcy regulations, company policies, audit requirements, and industry standards by maintaining current knowledge of applicable laws, procedures, and servicing practices.
  • Regular attendance and punctuality during scheduled work hours are essential functions of this position. The position requires the employee to report as scheduled and on time and to be present during the hours necessary to perform the position’s essential duties and meet operational requirements.

raw.description:
About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we’re growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

Position Summary

As a Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) at Blackbird Health, you’ll play an essential role in delivering high-quality, comprehensive psychiatric evaluations, treatment planning, and medication management for children, adolescents, and young adults. You’ll build meaningful relationships with patients and families, taking the time to understand their needs, support engagement in treatment, and educate them on care options that foster long-term progress.

Working alongside an interdisciplinary team of psychotherapists, specialists, and clinical leaders, you’ll be empowered to make a tangible difference in the lives of young patients and their families through compassionate, evidence-based care.

We’re seeking dedicated prescribers to join our team and serve children, adolescents, and young adults ages 2–26. Multiple remote employment tracks are available: you’ll select your preferred arrangement in the application.

Employment Options

W2 Full-Time (FTE) | PMHNP

  • Compensation:
    • Base Salary: $135,000 – $145,000 base salary.
  • Hours & Schedule:
    • Workload: Fully remote position with a commitment supporting completed clinical direct care hours.
    • Commitment: 34 clinical direct-care hours per week.
    • Core Hours: Minimum commitment during peak "after school" core windows (after 4:00 PM ET weekdays and/or weekends).
  • Full Benefits Package: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, employer-paid life insurance, generous paid time off + 11 paid holidays, and professional liability insurance coverage.

W2 Part-Time (20 hrs/week) | PMHNP

  • Compensation:
    • Base Salary: $72,500 base salary for part-time schedule.
    • Incentive Pay: Earn $100 per completed clinical hour for additional sessions beyond your base caseload.
  • Hours & Onsite Expectations:
    • Commitment: 20 contracted hours per week (17 clinical direct-care hours).
    • Core Schedule: Minimum 15 hours anchored in peak core windows (after 3:00 PM ET weekdays and/or weekends).
  • Benefits: Full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, generous PTO + 11 paid holidays, paid weekly clinical consultation, and covered liability insurance.

1099 Contractor | PMHNP

  • Compensation (Flat-Rate VA):
    • Hourly Pay: $120.00 flat rate per completed clinical hour.
  • Hours & Flexibility:
    • Minimum Commitment: 15 open patient-care hours/week to support a target baseline of 12 completed clinical hours/week.
    • Core Requirement: Hours anchored during peak core windows (after 3:00 PM ET weekdays and/or weekends).
  • Perks: Full credentialing support, paid weekly clinical consultation, liability insurance covered, and reimbursement for client no-shows.

Why Blackbird & Your Impact

  • Focus on Patient Care: Full administrative support—we handle credentialing, billing, insurance, and EHR administration so you can focus entirely on your clinical work.
  • Guaranteed Patient Referrals: Start seeing patients right away with a predictable caseload.
  • Grow as a Clinician: Paid weekly clinical consultation and peer support are built into your schedule for ongoing skill development.
  • Integrated Care Model: Work closely alongside psychotherapists, speech therapists, OTs, and neuropsychology specialists to treat the whole child.
  • Mission-Driven Culture: Join a collaborative, intelligent, and compassionate network of professionals shaping the future of pediatric behavioral health.

Who You Are

  • Licensure: Active Virginia PMHNP/CRNP/APN license, active DEA registration, and State Prescriptive Authority.
  • Certification: Board Certified by ANCC or AANP (PMHNP-BC).

raw.description:
Imagine yourself…

  • Owning your ambition and fueling your career growth.
  • Joining a company with a proven track record of success and an exciting future.
  • Collaborating with a vibrant, inclusive, global team.

It's all possible with a role at ​Esko​. Esko, a ​Veralto​ company, is a global provider of integrated software and hardware solutions that accelerate the go-to-market process of packaged goods. Our integrated platform and comprehensive tools empower retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers, and converters to manage best-in-class packaging design and print processes.

Innovation is built into the DNA of our business: every day, we challenge ourselves to be better by seeking out new ways to elevate our products, our processes, and our people.

We also know that innovation and ingenuity starts with prioritizing a diverse workforce and a deeply inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.

Learn about our leading portfolio of innovative products:


About the Role


Reporting to the Director of Sales, the Account Executive, Mid-Market Pharma & Life Sciences is responsible for winning new mid-sized pharmaceutical and life-sciences customers for Esko's validated brand software, starting with WebCenter Go. This is a newly created role in a growing segment, with real ownership in shaping how we win in this market. You'll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through solution design and close, focusing primarily on net-new revenue while identifying selective expansion opportunities within a small set of assigned accounts. You'll help pharmaceutical companies improve how they manage packaging artwork, labeling, review, approval, compliance and go-to-market workflows, delivering greater control, speed to market and measurable business impact. Working closely with Solutions Consulting, Product, Validation, Marketing and Customer Success, you'll translate regulated business requirements into practical outcomes and position validated software as a scalable solution for mid-sized life-sciences organizations, while growing your career within a global technology company where innovation is embedded in everything we do.


This is a fully remote role and will be located in the United States, within the Eastern or Central time zone (East Coast preferred).

What You'll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Own mid market pharma and life sciences segment, managing a healthy pipeline and achieving quarterly and annual revenue targets.
  • Drive the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting and qualification through discovery, demonstration, proposal, negotiation, and close. This is a hands-on hunter role with primary responsibility for winning new customers.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with key stakeholders—including marketing, regulatory ,procurement, packaging and IT decision-makers—within the region
  • Position the value of Validated Software in terms of process control, traceability, data integrity, inspection readiness, speed to market, quality and risk reduction.
  • Develop account plans that identify upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities across Esko's portfolio of software solutions.
  • Partner with Solutions Consultants and Customer Success Managers to deliver compelling, outcome-driven product demonstrations and value assessments.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to execute regional demand generation campaigns and convert inbound leads into qualified opportunities. Represent Esko at relevant events.
  • Analyze win/loss trends, competitive dynamics, and market signals to continuously sharpen your go-to-market approach and territory strategy.
  • Deliver accurate and timely pipeline reporting, forecasting, and CRM hygiene within Salesforce to support business planning and leadership visibility.
  • Champion Esko's value proposition ensuring prospects and customers understand the ROI of our integrated platform.
  • Travel may be required based on business needs, customer engagement requirements, and the complexity of opportunities.

What We're Looking For

These are the must-have requirements for the role:

  • Experience selling into life sciences (pharma, biotech, medical device, CDMO or consumer health), ideally software that touches GxP, quality, regulatory or labeling processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate multi-stakeholder SaaS sales while maintaining the pace, prioritization and commercial discipline required in a mid-market environment.
  • Experience with CRM tools (Salesforce or equivalent) for pipeline management, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present to both technical and business audiences.

These are nice-to-have skills that will set candidates apart:

  • Experience selling validated SaaS, quality-management, regulatory, labeling, artwork-management, document-management or compliance solution
  • Experience with value-based or consultative selling methodologies e.g., MEDDIC.
  • Working knowledge of computer system validation (CSV/CSA), 21 CFR Part 11 and how validated SaaS is bought, implemented and maintained.
  • Self-starter energy suited to a new, evolving motion; you like building process as much as following it.

Education

  • Minimum – Bachelor's degree ; MBA or equivalent preferred

We offer:

  • Permissive PTO
  • Flexible working hours
  • Professional onboarding and training options
  • Powerful team looking forward to working with you
  • Career coaching and development opportunities
  • Health benefits
  • 401(k)

About Veralto

Esko is proud to be part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto's vibrant global network of 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you'll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we're Safeguarding the World's Most Vital Resources™—and building rewarding careers along the way.

raw.excerpt: About ISACAISACA® (www. isaca. org) champions the global workforce advancing trust in technology.
raw.description:
About ISACA

ISACA® (www.isaca.org) champions the global workforce advancing trust in technology. For more than 55 years, ISACA has empowered its community of 195,000+ members with the knowledge, credentials, training and network they need to thrive in fields like information security, governance, assurance, risk management, data privacy and emerging tech. With a presence in more than 195 countries and with more than 230 chapters worldwide, ISACA offers resources tailored to every stage of members’ careers—helping them to thrive in a rapidly changing digital landscape, drive trusted innovation and ensure a more secure digital world. Through the ISACA Foundation, ISACA also expands IT and education career pathways, fostering opportunities to grow the next generation of technology professionals.

Overview

The AI/ML Lead is a senior, hands-on engineer and the first member of ISACA's AI implementation team, a new internal capability that will take on AI engineering work currently delivered by external vendors. Reporting to the VP, Application Engineering, and working within the platform architecture, standards, and governance set by the Senior Director, AI Architecture, Platforms & Agentic Systems, this role builds and hardens the AI solutions that serve ISACA's members and business, both those in delivery today and those that emerge as ISACA's AI portfolio grows. The initial focus is ISACA's personalized member experience, a production RAG and knowledge graph-based recommendation system that integrates ISACA's Body of Knowledge, certification details, workforce skills data, and member profile information. The majority of the role is spent implementing: writing production code, building data and retrieval pipelines, and operationalizing the engineering practices that keep AI systems reliable. Success is measured by production stability, the share of AI engineering work brought in-house, and the implementation team's growing ability to deliver ISACA's current and future AI needs without vendor dependency.

Responsibilities

AI Platform Technical Contribution

  • Provide hands-on engineering for the development, integration, and production delivery of ISACA's AI solutions, beginning with the AI-driven member experience, working within the platform architecture and standards set by the Senior Director, AI Architecture. Build and maintain core AI components, including knowledge graph ontology and configuration (Graphwise or a comparable enterprise knowledge graph platform), embedding and retrieval pipelines, recommendation logic, and LLM-powered and agentic application components. Implement the APIs and service contracts that connect AI capabilities to ISACA's digital experiences and business systems. Ensure all components are built for reuse, long-term internal ownership, and maintainability.

AI Vendor Oversight & Insourcing

  • Serve as the key internal technical counterpart to external AI development vendors and contractors. Participate in vendor architecture reviews and review vendor code and pull requests, evaluating AI solution designs, including RAG pipelines, knowledge graph implementation, and LLM integration, against ISACA's technical requirements and the engineering standards set by the Senior Director, AI Architecture. Define and maintain acceptance criteria for vendor deliverables, support production readiness validation, and surface technical risk or delivery misalignment to the Senior Director, AI Architecture, and IT leadership. Lead knowledge transfer so that vendor-built components move to internal ownership on a planned timeline, progressively reducing vendor dependency.

AI Engineering Practices & Operations

  • Implement and operate MLOps and LLMOps practices in line with the platform standards set by the Senior Director, AI Architecture, including CI/CD for ML and LLM pipelines, model and prompt versioning, evaluation, monitoring, drift detection, and token cost tracking. Establish team-level engineering practices, including code review, documentation, runbooks, and reusable components, that promote quality and consistency across the implementation team and sustain ISACA's AI solutions beyond any single initiative. Foster knowledge sharing so that expertise is built into the organization rather than held by individuals. Implement the security, responsible AI, and auditability controls defined by the Senior Director and Security within the AI solutions the team builds.

Data Infrastructure & AI Data Enablement

  • Build and maintain the data foundations that supply ISACA's AI solutions with reliable, well-structured inputs. Implement ingestion and transformation pipelines from source systems such as CRM, third-party content and learning platforms, and external workforce and market trend data. Implement data contracts with source-system owners, plus data quality checks and monitoring aligned to the standards set by the Senior Director, AI Architecture. Identify and document gaps in ISACA's current data architecture that limit AI performance or extensibility, and work with data, engineering, and product teams to close them.

AI Implementation Team Building

  • Serve as the first engineer on ISACA's AI implementation team. Recommend roles and hiring sequence to bring outsourced AI engineering in-house, participate in hiring and onboarding, and mentor engineers and contractors.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Translate AI system decisions, technical risks, and engineering tradeoffs into clear, actionable communication for product, engineering and IT stakeholders. Collaborate across product, architecture, security, and data teams to ensure AI initiatives integrate coherently into ISACA’s broader enterprise.

Other Duties

  • Evaluate emerging AI tools, platforms, and architectures through hands-on experimentation and proofs of concept, providing practical recommendations that support the Senior Director's build-versus-buy and platform decisions.

Qualifications

Required Field of Study:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Minimum Years of Experience Required:

  • 8+ years of professional software, data, or application development experience, including 2+ years of hands-on experience developing, implementing, or integrating AI, generative AI, LLM-powered, or agentic AI solutions in production environments, beyond proof-of-concept work.

Description of Minimum Relevant Experience Required:

  • Production delivery of LLM-powered or AI solutions in cloud environments (Azure strongly preferred or equivalent), including experience with LLM integration, RAG pipeline architecture, and model evaluation beyond proof-of-concept work.
  • Proficiency in Python and LLM application frameworks and SDKs; working knowledge of LLM evaluation, RAG pipeline performance tracking, and prompt versioning practices using tools such as Microsoft Foundry, Azure Promptflow, or equivalent evaluation frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, prompt engineering, embedding-based semantic retrieval, vector databases (e.g., Azure AI Search, Pinecone, or Weaviate), and LLM orchestration. Familiarity with multi-agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Microsoft AutoGen, or comparable) is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with knowledge graph architectures and ontology design; direct Graphwise experience is a strong plus. Working knowledge of Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or Azure Cosmos DB provides transferable graph reasoning skills and is helpful.
  • Foundational MLOps and LLMOps capability: CI/CD for ML and LLM pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions), containerized deployment (Docker/Kubernetes), model and prompt versioning, monitoring, token cost tracking, and drift detection. Familiarity with data and workflow pipeline orchestration tools such as Azure Data Factory or Apache Airflow is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to oversee AI vendor work through technical architecture review, acceptance criteria definition, and delivery validation.
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills: proven ability to translate AI architecture decisions, risks, and tradeoffs for non-technical audiences including product and engineering stakeholders.
  • Experience working in agile delivery environments with cross-functional product, engineering, data, and security teams.

Preferred Field of Study:

  • Masters Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or Artificial Intelligence

Preferred Years of Experience:

  • 10+ years of professional software or data engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience developing, implementing, or integrating AI, generative AI, LLM-powered, or agentic AI solutions, ideally including early-stage or greenfield AI systems delivered at enterprise scale.

Description of Preferred Relevant Experience:

  • Experience contributing to or helping shape an AI or data practice — establishing engineering practices and delivery patterns. Experience helping build or scale an engineering team is beneficial.
  • Domain literacy in IT governance, cybersecurity risk management, or professional certification ecosystems — sufficient to collaborate effectively with ISACA's internal subject-matter experts and align AI outputs to organizational standards.
  • Experience with knowledge graph reasoning, or GraphRAG patterns relevant to professional knowledge and competency ontology use cases.
  • Familiarity with bias and fairness evaluation for AI-driven recommendation systems, including output-level testing for demographic or professional skew
  • Prior experience working in a non-profit, professional association, standards body, or other mission-driven organization is a plus.
  • Experience collaborating across hybrid delivery models including in-house staff, contractors, and external development vendors.
  • Proficiency with Azure AI platforms, or equivalent services on AWS or GCP. Azure is the primary cloud platform for this role.
  • Familiarity with enterprise platforms commonly used in ISACA's ecosystem, such as Salesforce, Sitecore, and Microsoft Azure environments, is a plus.
  • Working familiarity with responsible AI principles and general awareness of relevant AI regulatory trends.

Certification and Licensing Preferred:

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure AI App and Agent Developer Associate (AI-103) or MLOps Engineer Associate (AI-300); prior Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100) also recognized
  • AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional or Machine Learning Engineer – Associate, or Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer

Competencies/Skills Required:

  • Strong customer and member focus, with the ability to design and deliver AI systems that reflect ISACA’s commitment to professional excellence and digital trust
  • A senior hands-on engineer who writes production code, reviews vendor work, and helps grow an internal implementation team.
  • Intellectual adaptability and continuous learning orientation; ability to rapidly develop fluency in new architectures and tools as they emerge.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking; ability to evaluate tradeoffs between innovation, delivery constraints, cost, and risk in early-stage AI programs
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to explain AI architecture decisions, technical risks, and engineering tradeoffs to technical and product stakeholders
  • Collaborative working style, with the ability to build alignment across engineering, product, data, and security teams without direct authority.
  • Self-starter capable of operating autonomously in environments with evolving requirements and incomplete information
  • Commitment to ISACA’s mission, purpose, and values; cultural sensitivity and awareness appropriate for a global professional membership organization.

This position may require periodic onsite attendance, either currently or in the future, based on business needs. Occasional travel may also be required to attend company-sponsored events, meetings, all-hands gatherings, training sessions, or other activities necessary to support the essential functions of the role.

Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO)

ISACA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. ISACA is committed to building an environment of diversity, equity, and inclusion where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, age, ancestry, disability, genetic information, citizenship, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status, familial status, military discharge status, or any other characteristic or status protected by federal, state, or local law. We support an inclusive workplace where employees excel based on merit, qualifications, experience, and ability.

raw.description:
Imagineeer is a fast-growing SBA 8(a) Small Disadvantaged Business headquartered in Arlington, VA, delivering federal AI modernization across health, defense, homeland security, and transportation. We design, test, and deploy secure, AI-ready systems that move agencies from pilots to production without breaking governance, compliance, or mission continuity. Our Mission Studio model creates shared environments where policy, data, security, and operations come together. We are capability-driven and competitive by design, not program-dependent. Our leadership has operated inside the federal systems we now transform, bringing institutional knowledge that accelerates delivery and reduces risk. If real delivery motivates you more than slides, and you want your work to compound across programs and agencies, Imagineeer is growing and we are building the team to match.

About the role

Imagineeer is seeking an experienced Oracle DBA/Developer to join our team supporting the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) Human Resources Information Technology (HRIT) contract. In this role, you will help modernize how HHS receives, processes, and uses critical HR and payroll data by consolidating and standardizing key federal data file exchanges, building reliable Oracle-based intake and processing workflows, and analyzing a large enterprise HR data environment to document how its tables, reports, and downstream data exchanges are used across the Department. This is a hands-on technical role for someone who enjoys bringing structure and clarity to complex data systems and who can work effectively with both technical teams and government stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support consolidation of CIDB files, including obtaining the CIDB Full file from Office of Personnel Management (OPM) and generating the CIDB Abbreviated file internally to eliminate reliance on externally supplied abbreviated extracts.
  • Standardize the intake, format, and processing of the Admin (SAC Codes) file received from OPM.
  • Standardize the intake, format, and processing of the Paytran file, including developing a file format specification to share with OPM and establishing receipt of the file from OPM
  • Analyze the technical usage of the Enterprise Human Capital Management (EHCM) data dump, including reviewing 100+ data tables to determine purpose and usage, identifying derived files, associated reports, and data exchanges with HHS Operating Divisions (OPDIVs) that rely on the data dump.
  • Design, develop, and maintain PL/SQL packages, procedures, and ETL processes to ingest, validate, and transform incoming data files.
  • Perform Oracle database administration tasks, including performance tuning, schema management, backup and recovery, and security configuration.
  • Produce technical documentation, including data dictionaries, data lineage, file format specifications, and standard operating procedures.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of experience as an Oracle DBA and/or Oracle Developer
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and PL/SQL, including stored procedures, complex queries, and performance tuning
  • Experience building ETL processes for flat-file ingestion (fixed-width and delimited) using SQL*Loader, external tables, or equivalent tools
  • Experience developing file format specifications or interface control documents for external data exchanges
  • Experience standardizing and consolidating data file processes
  • Experience working with OPM file exchanges
  • Ability to analyze large, complex data sets to determine purpose, usage, and downstream dependencies
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Desired Skills and Competencies:

  • Familiarity with Oracle HCM / EHCM data structures
  • Experience with federal HR and payroll data, such as EHRI, personnel and payroll transaction data, or the OPM Guide to Data Standards
  • Prior experience supporting HHS or other federal civilian agencies
  • Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) certification
  • Scripting experience (Python, Shell) to automate file processing

Additional Information:

Employment for this position is contingent upon the candidate being a United States citizen and having the ability to successfully obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance, in accordance with applicable federal regulations. We use AI to review resumes. All hiring decisions will be made in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations

TITLE: Patient Financial Specialist - Riedman - Remote, Financial Services (Full-Time, Days)

DEPARTMENT: Financial Services

LOCATION: Riedman - Remote

HOURS PER WEEK: 40

SCHEDULE: M-F, 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM

SUMMARY:
The Patient Financial Specialist is responsible for the complete patient billing cycle of surgical patients. This includes assisting with out-of-pocket balances, payment plans, and referring for financial aid and insurance enrollment. This role will be a liaison with the estimate, surgical scheduling, and registration departments to assist surgical patients with their financial needs and questions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist patients with obtaining acceptable payment methods, including but not limited to required surgical procedure down payments and payment plan arrangements.
  • Collaborate with financial aid and insurance enrollment teams for uninsured patients and/or those potentially eligible for financial assistance, ensuring patients are connected with the appropriate teams when needed.
  • Work directly with patients, either over the phone or in person, to discuss financial arrangements for medical procedures.
  • Act as a liaison between patients, front-end billing, back-end billing, and physician offices when coordinating financial arrangements for future procedures.
  • Assist in resolving basic billing questions or concerns, including questions related to procedure estimates.
  • Follow up on patient balances after procedures, which may include managing credit balances, issuing refunds, or discussing additional amounts due.
  • Monitor delinquent payment plans and work with patients to bring accounts current or replace cards on file that are inactive or declining.
  • Liaise with surgical scheduling, estimating, and office management teams to ensure all elements related to patient prepayments for scheduled surgeries are reviewed.
  • Analyze outcomes to identify opportunities for workflow improvements.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum of six (6) years of verifiable work experience in healthcare financial or revenue cycle roles, including medical billing, patient registration, patient financial services, or related finance/customer service positions.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • General knowledge of the healthcare billing arena.
  • Ability to work with various levels of management and physicians, remaining professional with various types of communication.
  • Remain professional and focused under multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Ability to articulate and discuss financial details with patients in a calm, professional manner.
  • Experience with Google spreadsheets or Microsoft Excel spreadsheets.
  • Experience with analytical duties and acquired skills to make decisions on a process flow and point out areas of possible improvement.

EDUCATION:

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS:

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Sedentary - Sedentary roles are primarily office-based and require prolonged sitting (67–100% of the workday) with minimal physical effort and lifting limited to under 10 lbs. Fine motor skills are necessary for computer work, writing, and telephone use, supported by clear visual and auditory ability. Cognitive and emotional demands are high due to extended concentration, frequent interruptions, independent decision-making, and information processing. Although physical exposure is low, administrative areas within healthcare environments may occasionally involve contact with infectious agents. Some roles may require flexible hours, TB screening, or a valid driver’s license.

For disease specific care programs refer to the program specific requirements of the department for further specifications on experience and educational expectations, including continuing education requirements.

Any physical requirements reported by a prospective employee and/or employee’s physician or delegate will be considered for accommodations.

PAY RANGE:

$21.00 - $27.00

CITY:

Rochester

POSTAL CODE:

14617

The posted pay range is a good faith representation of potential base pay for this position. It may be modified in the future and eligible for additional pay components. Individual annual salaries/hourly rates could vary based on position details and FTE. Pay is determined by considering factors including, but not limited to, experience, relevant qualifications, specialty, internal equity, locations, and contracts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and standardize SLO/SLI frameworks and error-budget policies across multiple engineering groups.
  • Lead the design and rollout of secure, scalable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and cloud-native Kubernetes environments.
  • Drive observability strategy by evaluating, implementing, and optimizing telemetry solutions across distributed systems.
  • Lead incident response during critical system events, facilitating blameless post-incident reviews and driving systemic mitigation strategies.
  • Build core automation frameworks and platform tools (in Python or Go) that eliminate operational friction and enforce security compliance automatically.
  • Mentor and advise software and reliability engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and engineering quality.

Must-Have Requirements

  • Demonstrated Experience: 5+ years of experience (or equivalent demonstrated capability) managing high-throughput distributed systems and cloud infrastructure at scale.
  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced expertise in Kubernetes, Linux internals, cloud networking, and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, AWS).
  • Software Engineering: Strong proficiency in high-level programming languages (Python or Go) for building automation tools and system integrations.
  • Incident & Reliability Leadership: Proven track record leading incident response, blameless post-mortems, and root-cause prevention across complex architectures.
  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice-to-Have Requirements

  • Professional certifications in Kubernetes (CKA, CKS) or cloud providers (AWS Solutions Architect).
  • Solid understanding of compliance and security frameworks (SOC 2, CIS benchmarks) embedded directly into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience leveraging Gen AI tools to accelerate development workflows and diagnostic automation.

More about OutSystems

OutSystems is a leading AI Development Platform built for the enterprise.
